title: Creative Director
description:
**Creative Director** 




 Live visuals across brand, music and culture
 



  





 Location: Central London studio, 5\-day week, 2\-3 days WFH
 



 Salary: £75,000
 



 Type: Permanent, Full\-time
 



  





**About rapt** 





 rapt is a multimedia studio making immersive and interactive experiences. A Projection show on a landmark building, LED at stage scale, real\-time visuals. One month a campaign launch in London, the next live visuals for an arena tour, the next an installation in a disused power station or the Nevada desert.
 




  






 We work with global brands, artists and cultural institutions. Previous names include BOSS, Nike, Valentino, McLaren, New Balance, TAG Heuer, Audemars Piguet, Netflix and Diageo. And the work doesn't stop with brands. We have an artistic practice of our own, and the self\-initiated work feeds back into everything else. The last thing we want an audience to feel is nothing.
 




  






 We're a small team working on big projects all over the world, and the studio is growing. This role plays a real part in shaping what it becomes next.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Creative Director to lead creative across pitches and live projects. Sharp conceptual thinking, a strong visual sensibility, and the ability to take an idea from first response through to what the audience actually experiences. Projects range from arena tours and festival main stages to building\-scale projection and gallery installations.
 



  





 This is a creative director with a producer's hat on. You need to know what it takes to make the idea real. Which people, how many days, what budget, what pipeline, and whether it lands on time. Not just the creative, but how realistic the creative is to deliver. You'll lead teams made up of internal people and external specialists, built per project from our freelance roster. You brief them, run them and sign off their work.
 



  





 You'll be running several pitches and several projects at the same time. Being highly organised isn't a nice\-to\-have here.
 



  





 You'll need to be fluent in immersive formats and creative technology, confident communicating ideas to clients and internal teams, and hands\-on enough to sketch, write or visualise ideas yourself when needed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Pitches* 



* Lead creative direction on pitch responses. Approach every brief strategically: what the objective is, who the audience is, and what the angle is that wins it.
* Translate briefs into clear creative strategy and strong, original ideas.
* Shape visual concepts, narratives and deck content.
* Scope the content side: team, days and cost, working with the project manager. If the idea can't be built for the number, say so early.



  





*Projects* 



* Own creative quality from concept through production to delivery on site.
* Build, brief and manage freelance content teams from our roster: 2D, 3D, real\-time, interactive, sound.
* Plan the content production: schedule it, resource it, track it, keep it on budget with the help of our internal team.
* Review and sign off content before it goes to the client or hits the media server.
* Present work to clients and collaborators with clarity and confidence.



  





*Studio* 



* Uphold creative standards across everything that leaves the studio.
* Motivate and guide creative teams across disciplines, from concept to delivery.
* Feed into internal R\&D and help shape the future creative direction of rapt.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 



* Proven experience making work for big spaces and big crowds, arena screens, building facades, one\-off sites, not just standard agency\-format content.
* A hands\-on tools background. You've come up through making, whether design, 3D, motion or real\-time, and grown into creative direction. You know roughly how a thing gets built and can navigate a project through it. Time spent agency side and a track record of winning pitches are both a plus.
* Strong creative strategy skills and an ability to frame ideas clearly for clients.
* Producer's instincts. You've scoped and costed content production before and know what a team of artists actually takes, in people, days and money.
* A clear eye for design, narrative and spatial storytelling.
* You can illustrate your own ideas. Sketch, storyboard, style frame, mock up. When you show an idea, people see it.
* Working knowledge of 2D, 3D, real\-time (Unreal, Notch, TouchDesigner) and Gen AI workflows.
* Experience working across immersive, spatial, digital or experiential formats.
* Experience building and managing freelance teams.
* Comfort collaborating with technical and production teams across disciplines.
* Highly organised. Able to lead multiple pitches and projects at once through ambiguity and deadlines without the quality slipping.
* Strong communication skills and confidence presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Live work sometimes means evenings and weekends on site.



  





**Perks** 



* 22 days holiday (plus public holidays), increasing with tenure
* Birthday off
* Private healthcare (including dentist and optician)
* Hybrid working (2\-3 days WFH per week)



  





**How to apply** 




 Please email your:
 


* CV
* Portfolio



 Email to: opportunities@rapt.co
 



 Deadline for Application: 4th October

 Experience Design Director \- EA SPORTS Network

 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and
   

  

 fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that

 EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top\-
   

  

 selling videogame franchises, award\-winning interactive technology, fan programs,

 that ignite the emotion of sport through industry\-leading sports video games,
   

  

 including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
   

  

 EA SPORTS UFC .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 Experience Strategy:
   

  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long\-term, multi\-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network\-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user\-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.


**Experience Innovation \& Data Informed Design**
* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next\-generation interaction models, including AI\-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real\-time sports feed integrations.
* Data\-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

* Experience: 10\+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world\-class, large\-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

title: Art Director
description:
**Company and Vision**  

  

PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make\-on\-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end\-to\-end customer experience that result in high\-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of life events.  

  

The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading SimplytoImpress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit www.planetart.com to learn more about our brands.  

  

We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company\-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe.
  

  

**Job Overview**
  

  

We are seeking a creative, strategic, and detail\-oriented Art Director to lead and elevate the visual identity of our growing portfolio of our brands. This individual will play a key role in shaping the look and feel of our customer \- facing content across digital channels, ensuring cohesive and compelling storytelling that drives engagement and performance.
  

  

As Art Director, you will guide a talented team of designers and collaborate cross\-functionally with marketing, merchandising, and external partners. You’ll be responsible for art direction, brand consistency, and the creation of high\-impact visual assets for email, social media, digital ads, eCommerce, and more. This role balances hands\-on design work with leadership and project oversight, making it ideal for a creative leader who thrives in both execution and mentorship.  

  

The ideal candidate is a visionary designer with strong branding instincts, excellent communication skills, and the ability to make data\-informed creative decisions. If you’re passionate about design and translating brand strategy into captivating visuals, we’d love to meet you.
  

  

PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be local to or willing to relocate to the Calabasas area as we operate on a hybrid work model (3 days onsite, 2 remote)  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Art Direction:**

* Lead the creative vision and visual identity for Personal Creations (US/UK), Gifts.com, Amazon brands (Let's Make Memories and RedEnvelope), and Etsy storefronts, ensuring consistent brand execution across all customer touchpoints.
* Establish, evolve, and maintain brand standards while providing creative direction to designers, copywriters, marketing, merchandising, and external creative partners.
* Oversee the creative development and approval of digital assets including email campaigns, social media, digital advertising, Amazon content, product imagery, video, and ecommerce experiences.
* Partner with Marketing and Merchandising to develop seasonal creative strategies, promotional campaigns, and content calendars aligned with business objectives.
* Direct photography and video concepts, collaborating with internal and external production partners to ensure assets support marketing and merchandising initiatives.
* Monitor customer insights, performance metrics, and industry trends to recommend creative improvements, optimize customer engagement, and influence product presentation.
* Develop and maintain creative templates, design systems, and reusable assets that promote consistency and efficiency across marketing channels.
* Collaborate with the Creative Director to develop new concepts, creative initiatives, and innovative approaches that strengthen brand presence.

 **Design \& Creative Execution**

* Design and oversee high\-impact creative for websites, landing pages, email campaigns, social media, digital advertising, and ecommerce experiences.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to develop and execute A/B tests and user experience enhancements based on customer insights and business performance metrics.
* Create original concepts for new campaigns, product launches, photography, video, and emerging marketing channels.
* Provide hands\-on design support for priority initiatives, new creative concepts, and high\-visibility projects as business needs require.

Leverage the company’s proprietary AI ad producing platform for campaign development.  
* 

  

**Leadership \& Project Management**

* Lead, mentor, and provide day\-to\-day direction to the design team, fostering collaboration, creativity, and professional development.
* Prioritize and assign creative work based on business priorities, project timelines, and team capacity.
* Partner with Project Management, Marketing, and Merchandising to ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Review and approve creative work, provide constructive feedback, and ensure adherence to brand standards and quality expectations.
Communicate priorities, processes, and project status across cross\-functional teams while supporting an efficient creative workflow.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements** **What You Should Have**  

**Skills, Qualifications, and Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Visual Communications, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 3\+ years of professional experience as an Art Director or in a senior graphic design or creative leadership role.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design, branding, and art direction across digital marketing and ecommerce channels.
* Expertise in visual design principles, including composition, color theory, typography, and layout.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, with knowledge of production and print processes.
* Proven ability to develop original creative concepts from ideation through final execution.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and providing creative direction to designers while maintaining high quality standards.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present creative ideas and provide constructive feedback.
* Creative thinker with a passion for design, branding, emerging trends, and delivering engaging customer experiences.
Detail\-oriented with a commitment to producing polished, high\-quality creative work.  
* 

  

**What You Can Expect**  

**Working Conditions**  



* Work is performed in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels.
* Position requires regular, continuous use of computer.
* Position requires regular sitting and standing.
* Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: in\-person, phone, Zoom, Slack, or email.
* May require occasional travel.
* This is a hybrid position; employees are expected to be in the office three days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday) with the option of working remotely two days (Wednesday and Friday)

 **Benefits**  

The compensation range for this position is $75,000 \- $95,000 annual salary.

  

PlanetArt offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* 401(k) with matching
* Pet Insurance
* Mental Health Benefits
* Comprehensive Time Off Program, including Vacation, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, and Floating Holidays
* Employee Product Discounts

 26WD100658
   

  

**Creative Director, Product \& Experiences — Flow Studio (Remote)**
 Location: Remote US or Canada \| Los Angeles area preferred
   

  

 Organization: Flow Studio Product
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Creative Director** 
 to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
   

  

 This is an AI\-first, hands\-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands\-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast\-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
   

  

 You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
   

  

 You’ll also be the primary product\-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
   

  

 The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
   

  

**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in\-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.
* Create and direct ambitious AI filmmaking work—from cinematic showcases and product films to reference\-quality experiments that push the creative possibilities of Flow Studio.
* Work hands\-on with emerging AI image, video, performance, animation, and filmmaking tools; prototype new ideas, test new models and techniques, and turn experimentation into finished creative work.
* Shape the creative layer of the product itself, including cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, examples, templates, onboarding content, reusable scene elements, and other creator\-facing experiences.
* Bring strong filmmaking judgment to camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, visual treatment, and storytelling across the work.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering from early feature development through launch, translating new capabilities into compelling creative experiences and demonstrations.
* Act as the primary product\-side creative partner to Marketing for launches, campaigns, promotional films, social, web, events, and other external storytelling—helping shape concepts, scripts, storyboards, visuals, and execution.
* Identify opportunities around emerging AI, filmmaking, and social trends, and create culturally relevant, internet\-native work that is distinctive, timely, highly shareable, and capable of earning meaningful organic reach.
* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.


**Qualifications**
* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet\-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Flow Studio develops a recognizable creative voice and a consistently exceptional quality bar across the product, its content, and the work shown publicly.
* New product capabilities become films, demos, experiments, and creative experiences that make people immediately understand—and want to try—what Flow Studio can do.
* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high\-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet\-native experiments.

**JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE \#1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD** 




 Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry\-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting\-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award\-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.
 



  





 Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.
 



  





 But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real\-time support, and a community of like\-minded traders.
 



  





 So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.
 



  





 Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail\-focused trading platform in the world.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior\-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.
 



  





 Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.
 



  





 Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.
 



  





**In this role you will:** 




 The marketing identity system
 


* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it
* Establish the governance that keeps the system intact — standards, documentation, review, and the authority to say no
* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing



  





 Creative output and storytelling
 


* Concept and direct integrated campaigns from brief to launch — video, social, paid, OOH, sponsorship, events
* Develop the narrative, not just the look. You will shape the story a piece of video tells, then art\-direct the production that delivers it
* Own marketing web and landing page design, including the pages that carry acquisition and conversion volume
* Direct lifecycle and product marketing creative so the experience stays coherent from first impression to funded account
* Stay personally in the work on hero projects — concepting, designing, writing direction, cutting with the editor



  





 Team and partners
 


* Hire, manage and develop a small in\-house design team; set the critique culture and the standard
* Brief, direct and evaluate agencies, production partners and freelancers; own creative quality of outsourced work
* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production



  





 Cross\-functional leadership
 


* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes
* Operate fluently inside a regulated marketing environment, partnering with compliance early rather than treating review as a downstream tax



  





**What you'll need:** 



* 8\+ years of brand and creative experience, with 2\+ years leading a team as an ACD, CD or design lead
* A portfolio built on systems, not one\-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art\-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands\-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data



  





**Bonus Points for:** 



* Fintech, brokerage, trading, crypto or exchange experience, or genuine curiosity about markets and retail traders
* Experience operationalizing an inherited identity system rather than only building from scratch
* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming
* Practicing a craft outside the day job — photography, film, writing or illustration
* Agency background plus in\-house leadership experience



  





**Compensation:** 




 The salary range for this role will be $166,000\.00 \- $216,000\.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).
 



  





 Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401K plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3\.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 23 days per year plus seven paid holidays.
 



  





**Location:** 




 This role is based in Chicago, IL. \*There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.
 



  





**Hybrid:** 




 For Chicago\-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In\-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:
 


* 20 additional flex remote days annually
* 5 Company Wide Office\-Optional weeks tied to major holidays

* 1 Service Day Annually

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Thesis**
 Thesis is an independent agency working at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and technology. We partner with ambitious brands to solve complex business and marketing challenges and create ideas, experiences, and systems built to scale. We’re evolving how we work to bring thinking and making closer together, build more accountable teams, and use technology and AI to expand what’s creatively possible.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Creative Director at Thesis, you’ll establish the creative vision for the clients, teams, and opportunities you lead. You’ll turn business and audience challenges into ideas worth pursuing, build belief around those ideas, and lead multidisciplinary teams to make them real. You’re a thinker and a maker with strong taste, strategic instincts, and the ability to move between ideas and execution. You know when to get into the work and when to create space for others to lead. You’ll be accountable for the idea, the people, the client relationship, and the creative outcome, while managing, mentoring, and developing the next generation of creative leaders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Creative Vision \& Ideas**
* Establish the creative vision for assigned clients, accounts, and opportunities.
* Turn business, audience, and cultural insights into strong ideas and creative opportunities.
* Lead concept development and ensure ideas maintain their integrity as they scale across channels, experiences, and content.


**Strategic Thinking**
* Partner with Strategy and clients to define the problem and opportunity before defining the deliverable.
* Connect creative decisions to audience needs, brand ambition, culture, and business objectives.
* Look beyond the immediate ask to identify opportunities for greater client and creative impact.


**Creative \& People Leadership**
* Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, writing, motion, experience, content, and emerging disciplines.
* Set a high creative standard while staying close enough to the work to meaningfully shape and elevate it.
* Manage, mentor, and develop creative talent and emerging leaders through clear expectations, feedback, and meaningful opportunities for growth.
* Build teams that can increasingly operate with ownership and autonomy.


**Client Leadership \& Storytelling**
* Serve as a trusted creative partner to senior clients.
* Build belief in ideas through clear, compelling storytelling and presentations.
* Navigate feedback and business constraints while protecting the creative ambition.
* Build relationships that expand Thesis’s creative influence and uncover new opportunities.


**AI, Technology \& Making**
* Use AI and emerging technology to expand exploration, prototype ideas, accelerate learning, and increase the leverage of teams.
* Partner with Technology and Production to explore new ways of making and bringing ideas to life.
* Use technology to scale strong ideas without replacing human judgment, originality, and taste.


**Process \& Delivery**
* Own the creative outcome from opportunity through execution.
* Build the smallest, strongest team capable of solving the problem.
* Partner across Strategy, Technology, Client Leadership, Production, and Operations to reduce handoffs and create clear ownership.
* Balance creative ambition with scope, timing, resources, and business realities.


**Growth \& New Business**
* Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships through creativity, strategy, and technology.
* Play a leadership role in new business, from opportunity framing and concept development through pitching.
* Bring proactive ideas and provocations to clients before they’re requested.


**Who You Are**
* A multidisciplinary creative leader with experience leading significant creative work, teams, and client relationships.
* An ideas person, thinker, and maker who can move between strategy, creative direction, and execution.
* A creative with exceptional taste and judgment across disciplines.
* A leader who knows how to manage, mentor, and grow creative talent.
* A compelling storyteller who can build belief with clients, teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, direct client relationships, and the pace of agency work.
* Curious and experimental with AI, technology, and new ways of making.
* Collaborative, accountable, low ego, and capable of making the people around you better.


**Relationships**
* Reports to: Chief Creative Officer
* Direct Reports \& Teams: Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, writing, motion, experience, content, and emerging disciplines; manage, mentor, and develop creative talent and emerging leaders.
* Internal Cross\-Functional Partners: Partner across Strategy, Technology, Client Leadership, Production, and Operations.
* External Partners: Serve as a trusted creative partner to senior clients.


**Work Environment and Physical Demands**
**Requirements**
 The following capabilities are required in order to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations that do not create an undue burden on the agency are available to address the following requirements:

title: Creative Producer / Commercial Director – Social Media Ads
description:
**Please read first: this is NOT a videographer or camera operator job.** We already work with a professional videographer and a video editor. We need the person who decides *what* we shoot and *how* it should be directed so it becomes paid social ads that generate leads.

**About the role**

We produce paid social ads (Meta / Facebook / Instagram, Reels, TikTok) for local service businesses: roofing, windows and doors, motorized retractable screens, garage doors, construction / home improvement and other lead\-generation businesses. You will work with our marketing and media buying team, our videographer, our editor, and the business owners to turn each client's offer into a steady flow of strong ad creative.

You own the concept and the direction. The videographer executes the shots.

**Example of what we mean**

When we film for a roofing company, we don't want someone to show up and "film a roof." We want you to arrive with concepts, for example a hook like: "Most homeowners don't notice this roof problem until it costs them thousands." Then you decide what the roofer says, where he stands, what damage needs close\-up shots, what B\-roll and before/after shots we need, which customer questions to answer, which CTA to use, and which alternative hooks to record while we're there.

**What you will do**

* Research competitors and winning ads (Meta Ad Library, competitors' social accounts)
* Develop video ad concepts based on the offer, customer pain points and target audience
* Write hooks for the first 1–3 seconds, scripts and talking points
* Build shot lists and plan B\-roll and before/after content
* Plan testimonial, founder/owner\-led, educational and offer\-driven ads
* Direct business owners, employees, customers and actors on set (most are not professional actors)
* Tell the videographer exactly which shots are needed, and make sure multiple variations are captured at every shoot
* Plan multiple hooks, bodies, CTAs and thumbnails from the same shoot
* Give the editor clear, specific editing instructions
* Produce for vertical 9:16 (Reels, Facebook, TikTok)

title: Design Director
description:
**About Nen Creative**
----------------------


Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.


Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.


We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Design Director** to lead our brand and design practice.


This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role for someone who can set a high creative bar, lead and develop a multidisciplinary design team, and build strong relationships with clients.


You'll oversee creative quality across brand, web, and launch work from early concepts through final delivery. You'll work closely with our Brand Project Manager to keep projects moving effectively, while serving as the senior creative partner in key client conversations.


You'll also play an important role in new business — helping shape creative approaches, lead pitches and presentations, and show prospective clients what great work with Nen can look like.


We're looking for someone who can take meaningful ownership of the practice: improving the work, developing the team, strengthening how we operate, and helping us build the next chapter of Nen's brand offering.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Leadership:** Own the creative quality of our brand and design work across identity, web, and launch projects. Set the direction, push the work, and make sure everything that leaves the studio meets a high bar.

**Team Leadership:** Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary design team, helping designers grow their craft, thinking, presentation skills, and ability to work independently.

**Client Leadership:** Serve as the senior creative partner on key engagements. Lead important reviews and presentations, build trust with founders and senior stakeholders, and help navigate creative feedback and difficult decisions.

**New Business:** Participate in discovery, shape creative approaches, and lead or support pitches and presentations. Help us communicate Nen's point of view and win the kinds of projects we want to be doing.

**Process \& Practice Building:** Work closely with project management and leadership to improve critiques, QA, creative workflows, case studies, and how the brand practice operates as we grow.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **5–8 years of experience** in brand, design, or creative roles, ideally within a strong branding or creative agency environment.
* **Exceptional design judgment and craft.** You know what great looks like, can push work beyond the obvious, and are willing to challenge conventions to create something distinctive.
* **Extremely strong with clients.** You're confident presenting to founders and senior stakeholders, can articulate and defend creative decisions, manage feedback, and build trust quickly.
* **High ownership and reliability.** You do whatever it takes to get important work over the line, stay calm under pressure, and don't need someone chasing you to make things happen. This is not a role for someone looking for a strictly 9–5 mindset.
* **Able to move fluidly between direction and execution.** You can think at the highest level about the idea, strategy, and creative system, but you're also willing to get into the details and help make the work better when needed.
* **Driven to raise the bar.** You want to build better work, better processes, and a better team — not simply maintain what already exists.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Help shape the next stage of a fast\-growing independent creative studio.
* Take meaningful ownership over the quality and direction of our brand practice.
* Work directly with ambitious founders and some of the most exciting companies in technology.
* Have real influence over how we work, what we make, and the kind of studio we become.
* Remote\-friendly environment.
* Healthcare coverage.
* Paid time off and company holidays.

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**


At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.


Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**


Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.


At scale, yet agile – 3,000\+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands\-on.


Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long\-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  

**Job Purpose**


As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day\-to\-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.


You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow\-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first\-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must\-haves**

* 5\+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data\-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two\-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI\-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**


We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take\-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real\-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References \& Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross\-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**


At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.


Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.
  

  

  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  

  

  

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  

  

  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

BSC\-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit\-based Recruitment principles (OTM\-R). Our research group has been consistently developing contributions in the field of multi\-agent systems from several perspectives, including efficient methods for combining symbolic and sub\-symbolic forms of reasoning; scalable architectures for parallel distributed execution of large volumes of agents; mechanisms and languages for encoding, interpreting and analysing the effects of social values and norms; and explainability methods in cooperative and competitive settings.
  

We are looking for a research engineer to support and lead a number of ongoing research projects in Artificial Intelligence. These projects involve knowledge areas such as agents, explainability, autonomous decision\-making, multi\-agent coordination and communication, and AI systems in general, applied to a wide range of use cases.
  

The selected candidate will be responsible for the day\-to\-day advancements and follow\-up of project activities, including technical coordination, management, research and engineering support when needed. The role involves working closely with other engineers and research and support teams, technical staff, and external collaborators, ensuring that milestones, deliverables, and reporting obligations are met in accordance with funding requirements.  

  

**Key Duties**  

  

* Participate in engineering activities, including development and experimentation of artificial intelligence methods.
* Coordinate research project technical activities, including planning, execution, and tracking.
* Monitor project timelines and technical deliverables.
* Facilitate communication between researchers, developers, and external partners.
* Contribute to the preparation of technical reports, project documentation, and dissemination materials (in collaboration with dissemination professionals).
* Contribute to the preparation of new project proposals in collaboration with the PMO.
* Help ensure alignment with data protection, ELSEC, and open science requirements.
  

  

**Requirements**  

  

* Education
	+ Degree in a STEM field, ideally related to Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or Software Engineering
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Experience in participating in research or innovation projects (2 years of experience)
	+ Familiarity with AI or intelligent systems, either through work or academic background (3 years of experience)
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Experience working with publicly funded R\&D projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, national programs)
	+ Experience writing research proposals
	+ Experience in writing scientific papers
	+ Experience in multi\-agent systems
	+ Experience in reinforcement learning
	+ Experience in designing or implementing intelligent agents
	+ Mathematical and formal logics background is desirable
* Competences
	+ Ability to work in multidisciplinary environments
	+ Strong communication and organizational skills

  

**Conditions**  

  

* The position will be located at BSC within the Directors Department
* We offer a full\-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open\-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 22 days of holidays \+ 6 personal days \+ 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: 01/11/2026
  
  

**Applications procedure and process**  

  

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:  

  

  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.
  

  

  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  

  

  

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  

  

  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. \- ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*
  

  

  

  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  

  

  

In accordance with OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

  

  

  

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

  

  

  

  

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment \[at] bsc \[dot] es.
  

For more information, please follow this link.

  

  

  

  

**Deadline**  

  

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.  

  

**OTM\-R principles for selection processes**  

  

BSC\-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit\-based Recruitment principles (OTM\-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender\-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.
  

BSC\-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000\+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands\-on.


Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long\-term success.

Your main project is the listing\-based pricing rollout across markets. You'll diagnose what's working, propose fixes, get local and global teams on board, and roll out to new countries with clear targets and a steady weekly cadence. You'll also shape how the model evolves for next year.


You'll own the ARPU (average revenue per user) target for the segment. Alongside the main project, you'll:

* Adjust and follow up on budget assumptions as we learn from the market.

title: Lead VFX Artist
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main challenge**


We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.


You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in\-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **VFX Team Leadership:** Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
* **Visual Direction \& Quality:** Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
* **VFX Pipeline:** Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
* **Standards \& Workflows:** Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
* **Team Development:** Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

**What success will look like**


After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.


After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment journey**

* HR Screen Call
* Test
* Second Interview
* Final Interview

**Where this role can take you**


This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in real\-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real\-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
* Strong knowledge of industry\-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
* Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
* Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
* Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
* Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
* Willingness to work with in\-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
* Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
* Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
* Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
* You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
* You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
* You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries \& cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full\-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work\-from\-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit\-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after\-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**


Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross\-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!


Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

**Want to know more?** Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com


If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Senior Analyst / SME - EDD
description:
**About us:**



BVNK is the stablecoin\-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.



We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130\+ countries, with 40\+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.



Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world\-class team to make it happen.



Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.



By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.



We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.



We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:


* CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026\)
* FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross\-border Payment Companies (2026\)
* Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025\)
* LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025\)


**About this role in the team:**



Following enhancements to our Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) methodology and the implementation of expanded Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) standards, BVNK is expanding its Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR) team.


We are seeking a Senior EDD Analyst / Subject Matter Expert (SME) reporting directly to the Head of Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR). This high\-impact role will lead complex remediation activities, conduct advanced EDD reviews, perform direct customer AML control walkthroughs, and manage specialized regulatory and vertical assessments across onboarding and ongoing monitoring.


As a senior individual contributor and SME, you will handle high\-risk, multi\-layered corporate structures, complex product flows (e.g., Fiat Nested, Embedded Partner Managed), and specialized high\-risk verticals (e.g., Gambling, CFDs/High\-Risk Trading, Virtual Assets).


**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**


##### **1\. Remediation \& Advanced EDD Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end complex EDD remediation for high\-risk corporate clients under updated risk models.
* Conduct deep\-dive ownership analysis on multi\-layer structures (e.g., 3\+ layers of legal entities, trusts, foundations, offshore/secrecy jurisdictions), identifying Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) to 10% ownership thresholds.
* Verify Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) for entities and UBOs using commercial databases, tax returns, audited financials, and open\-source intelligence (OSINT).
* Execute jurisdiction\-specific EDD requirements across global operations (EU, UK, US, and APAC per local regulatory annexes).

##### **2\. Regulatory \& High\-Risk Vertical Assessments**


* Conduct full Regulatory Assessments for regulated clients (B2B/B2C) and nested/embedded models, including license verification against official registries, equivalence reviews, and scope/permission validation.
* Perform Geographic \& Reverse Solicitation Analyses, including "Initiative Tests" to identify active targeting of non\-licensed jurisdictions using digital, marketing, payment rail, and operational indicators.
* Conduct sector\-specific High\-Risk Vertical Assessments (e,g. Gambling, CFDs \& Leveraged Products, Virtual Assets \&CASPs) in line with BVNK guidance.
* Research regulatory standards and high\-risk verticals to support a risk\-based approach and present strategic recommendations to Second Line Compliance.

##### **3\. AML Control Walkthroughs \& Policy Reviews**


* Lead live AML Control Walkthroughs (video and occasionally in person) with client compliance and operational teams to test and validate their live CDD, payment screening, transaction monitoring, and SAR escalation environments.
* Perform desktop reviews of third\-party AML/CFT, Sanctions, and Transaction Monitoring, policies and procedures and external audit reports to identify material gaps and agree remediation action plans.

title: Lead Animator
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Your main challenge**


Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a **Lead Animator** to lead the animation team working on a new action\-based, multi\-platform IP featuring world\-famous characters from a major licensor.


Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **Lead and develop the animation team**, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
* **Own the animation quality bar**, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
* **Plan and oversee animation production**, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands\-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
* **Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation** to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* **Coordinate animation work with external partners**, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

**What success will look like**

**Within your first 3 months**, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

**Within 6 months**, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

**Within 9 months**, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the **Studio Art Development Director** and lead a team of **3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators**.


You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

**Your recruitment journey**


Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

* Recruiter interview
* Hiring team interview
* Animation assessment/test, where applicable
* Final interview

**Where this role can take you**


This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi\-platform IP.


You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Strong expertise in **3D character animation for games**, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
* Excellent understanding of **movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling**, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
* Ability to **establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards**, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
* Strong understanding of **game animation production and real\-time workflows**, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
* Professional experience with industry\-standard **3D animation tools and workflows**, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
* Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
* A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
* Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
* Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
* Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
* Hands\-on when needed, with a **lead\-by\-example** approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries \& cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full\-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work\-from\-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit\-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after\-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**


Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross\-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!


Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

**Want to know more?** Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com


If the offer interests you, Join the Game!
