title: VIE - Data Scientist F/M
description:
Sixense Satellite, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in satellite\-based ground monitoring. We develop advanced technologies combining remote sensing, InSAR, and data science to deliver high\-impact decision\-support solutions for infrastructure management, natural hazard monitoring, and land\-use planning.



As part of the VINCI Construction group, we help our clients better understand and anticipate ground deformation phenomena through Earth observation data and cutting\-edge technologies.

  


**About the Role :**



Sixense Satellite is looking for a Data Scientist to join our team and contribute to the development of our Atlas InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) processing chain. You'll work on both maintaining and extending core processing capabilities, and on building new features that push our satellite\-based ground deformation monitoring products forward.



This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of remote sensing, geophysics, and applied machine learning.

  


**What You'll Do :**


* Contribute to the design, development, and optimization of our InSAR tools and chain


* Implement new functionalities and features to expand processing capabilities and product offerings


* Design and deploy machine learning models, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for tasks such as phase unwrapping, atmospheric correction, anomaly/deformation detection, and signal classification


* Work with large volumes of SAR and interferometric data, building robust and scalable pipelines


* Collaborate closely with geophysicists, radar engineers, and software developers to translate research into production\-ready tools


* Validate model outputs against ground truth and domain expertise; iterate based on real\-world performance


* Contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing

 **What We're Looking For :**


* Degree (MSc/PhD) in Data Science, Computer Science, Geophysics, Remote Sensing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field


* Experience in machine learning, with hands\-on expertise in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)


* Strong Python programming skills; experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, xarray, etc.)


* Experience working with geospatial or remote sensing data (SAR/InSAR experience is a strong plus, but not mandatory)


* Familiarity with signal/image processing techniques


* Comfortable working with large datasets and building production\-grade data pipelines


* Strong analytical mindset and ability to work independently on open\-ended problems


* Excellent written and oral reporting skills in English are mandatory.


* Good communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team

  


**Nice to Have :**


* French or Spanish would be a valued skill.


* Prior experience with InSAR, SAR imagery, or satellite remote sensing


* Experience with cloud computing platforms and distributed processing


* Familiarity with geodesy or ground deformation monitoring

  


**How to Apply ?**



Interested candidates are invited to send their CV and a short cover letter to satellite@sixense\-group.com with the subject line "Data Scientist – InSAR Processing Chain".

 **Why Join Us ?**


* Work on cutting\-edge Earth observation technology with real\-world impact — infrastructure monitoring, natural hazard detection, mining, and more


* Direct influence on the evolution of our core processing chain


* Collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment

  

Sixense, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in the fields of infrastructure and construction project monitoring, engineering, and digitalization. Through its expertise in instrumentation, data analytics, consulting, and infrastructure lifecycle management, Sixense supports its clients at every stage of an asset's lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance.Present in 20 countries, Sixense relies on a network of local offices and international subsidiaries to help monitor infrastructure, enhance construction site safety, and optimize asset maintenance. Today, the Group brings together more than 840 employees and generated revenue of €124 million in 2025\.

title: Documentalist
description:
The Library of the Vall d’Hebron University Hospital (HUVH) provides essential information services to the entire campus, supporting clinical, academic and research activities. To strengthen the services specifically addressing the needs of the Vall d’Hebron Research Institute (VHIR), we are seeking a Documentalist who will join the hospital’s library team while being operationally part of the Secretariat for Scientific Governance and Policy Unit (SGPC) at VHIR.


The Secretariat for Scientific Governance and Policy Unit (SGPC) is responsible for the institution’s knowledge management and the coordination of a wide range of strategic, scientific and institutional activities, including the implementation of the institutional strategic plan, institutional evaluations, research performance monitoring through key performance indicators (KPIs), and support for the development and follow\-up of the institutional structure.


In this hybrid position, the selected candidate will work from within the HUVH Library to manage and coordinate all VHIR‑related activities, ensuring dedicated support for VHIR researchers in areas such as information retrieval, scientific publishing, Open Access, Open Science, research data management and researcher training. The role will act as a strategic link between the Library and VHIR, contributing to the optimisation, visibility and alignment of information services across the campus.

##### **Main responsibilities and duties:**

* User support and training: Provide personalised support to researchers and library users, and design and deliver training on information resources, bibliographic tools, Open Access, ORCID, research data management and generative AI.
* Research information and publishing support: Advise researchers on bibliographic searches, publication strategies, journal selection, Open Access routes and funder requirements, and support the management and deposit of publications in the institutional repository (Scentia).
* Open Science and research support: Support the implementation of VHIR’s Open Science Policy and contribute to institutional and external initiatives related to Open Science, research assessment and responsible research.
* Digital resources and content management: Manage access to digital information resources and maintain relevant Library and Open Science content on the VHIR website and intranet, including information on transformative agreements and APCs.
* Research visibility and institutional initiatives: Coordinate the institutional ORCID campaign, promote VHIR scientific publications through social media and Altmetric tools, and collaborate on library, institutional and community\-engagement initiatives.
##### **Education and qualifications:**

###### **Required:**

* Degree in Information and Documentation Management or diploma/degree in Library and Information Science.

###### **Desirable:**

* Specific training in documentation and/or digital content management.
* English level B1 or higher.
* Catalan language proficiency at C1 level or equivalent.
##### **Experience and knowledge:**

###### **Required:**

* Experience in specialised bibliographic searching and management.
* Experience in user training and the development of teaching materials.
* Knowledge of Open Access publishing and open data management.
* Advanced computer skills (Office 365\).

###### **Desirable:**

* Knowledge of AI tools and intellectual property aspects.
##### **Labour conditions:**

* **Working hours**: Full\-time (37,5 hours per week).
* **Starting date**: As soon as possible.
* **Gross annual salary**: Remuneration will be determined by experience, skills and responsibilities and aligned with the Collective Agreement pay scale.

* **A dynamic scientific environment of excellence**, where cutting\-edge biomedical projects are continuously developed.
* **Continuous learning and career development pathways**.
* **Flexible working hours**.
* **23 days of annual leave plus 9 personal days**.
* **Flexible remuneration programme**, including meal vouchers, health insurance, transport and more.
* **Corporate benefits platform**, offering significant discounts on travel, culture, technology, gastronomy, sports and more.
* **Healthy offering– “Feel Good, Feel VHIR”**: VHIR’s wellbeing programme offers a variety of activities to help staff thrive—physically, mentally, and socially. Through four pillars—Feel Well, Feel Connected, Feel Empowered, Feel Welcomed—it fosters health, growth, and community.
* **International mobility support (Welcome Services)**: we aim to make your arrival in Barcelona smooth and pleasant by providing city information, guidance on required procedures, access to the International Welcome Desk, family support and assistance with finding accommodation.

title: Systems Development Engineer, Managed Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high\-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in\-the\-works\-aws\-european\-sovereign\-cloud/
  

  

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day\-to\-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on\-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out\-of\-hours.
  

  

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high\-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best\-in\-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.
  

  

Utility Computing (UC)
  

European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
  

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
  

  

A Day in the Life
  

A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day\-to\-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long\-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time\-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on\-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out\-of\-hours.
  

  

Eligibility requirement
  

Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  

  

Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
  

  

Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
  

  

Employees will participate in an On\-Call rota.
  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience developing software code in one or more programming languages (java, python, etc.)
* Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
* This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
* Experience in engineering, working with hardware, software, networking, operating systems
* Experience designing systems for performance, simplicity, and scalability, durability, cost, and security.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Able to lead the creation, revision, and/or improvement of standard operational procedures (SOPs) and driving operational best practices.
* Experience actively mentoring junior engineers and working cross\-organizationally and leading strategic team efforts requiring work from multiple team members
* Experience operating 24x7 high\-availability, distributed software applications and performance tuning software applications and optimizing fleet utilization
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (such as CDK, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar) and monitoring frameworks (such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Elastic or similar).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Generative AI technologies, including automated deployment, configuration management, continuous integration workflows, prompt engineering, model deployment, and AI\-powered automation tools

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.


But that’s just the beginning:

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy\-preserving AI infrastructure.


The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.


This is a hands\-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship\-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.


The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

  

International travel is required.


Shall we mention that nice to have is the person needs to speak at least 3 languages (more as a marker of flexibility than anything else)

Business Development \& Partnerships

Team Leadership

* Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.
* Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.
* Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.


Strategic Representation

* Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.
* Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

 **You Have**

* 7\+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.
* Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.
* Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.
* Strong relationships with senior decision\-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience building and managing high\-performing teams.

* Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third\-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double\-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Head of Platform Engineering, Barcelona
description:
Head of Platform Engineering
  
About Seqera
  
  

Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity s biggest challenges through data\-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.
  
  

We re a global, remote\-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we re strengthening our internal foundations \- and that s where you come in.
  
  

About the role
  
  

We are seeking a leader for our Platform Infrastructure team. This role owns infrastructure at Seqera in both directions: the internal platform our engineers build on, and the infrastructure we ship to customers. A large share of our customers experience Seqera through the infrastructure your team produces, which means much of this work is a product surface held to a products quality bar.
  
  

You will lead a team of DevOps and security engineers, and you will be a key member in our architecture review process, where infrastructure, security, and operability are weighed at design time alongside every other significant technical decision. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to define how a growing engineering organization builds, ships, and operates.
  
  

You will report to the CTO.
  
  

What Youll Do
  
  

Own the reliability, security, and cost\-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, and the ongoing health of the platform \- what gets maintained, upgraded, and retired, not only what gets built.
  
  

Lead the technical launch of our dedicated single\-tenant hosting offering: tenancy and isolation model, provisioning, upgrade and patching strategy across many customer instances, operational tooling, and the per\-tenant cost model it will be priced against.
  
  

Own our Helm charts and Terraform provider as products \- versioned, documented, and tested against supported deployment topologies, with the compatibility obligations that customer\-deployed infrastructure carries.
  
  

Own CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and the supported path from empty repo to production, so that teams get pipelines, deployment standards, and observability defaults without assembling them each time.
  
  

**Make cloud cost an engineering discipline:** attribution by team and by tenant, anomaly alerting, an efficiency backlog with quantified savings, and cost as an input at design time rather than a surprise after the fact.
  
  

Lead our security posture in practice \- security architecture applied during design review, and the security story we present to enterprise and life\-sciences customers.
  
  

**Own our formal incident response:** severity definitions, an incident commander rotation, runbooks for our top failure modes, and blameless postmortems that change something.
  
  

Define what production\-ready means at Seqera \- tests, observability, documentation, runbooks \- and hold the bar consistently across teams.
  
  

Grow and develop the Platform Infrastructure team, including active hiring at the senior engineer level and active mentorship and career planning for the whole team.
  
  

Partner with engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to bring infrastructure expertise into decisions early.
  
  

About you
  
  

You have led infrastructure, platform, or SRE teams with direct accountability for production reliability, and you are still close enough to the work to review it, set the standard, and make architectural calls yourself.
  
  

You have deep Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform experience in enterprise settings, and strong opinions about infrastructure\-as\-code earned from operating it.
  
  

You have shipped infrastructure that customers deploy and run themselves. You know that charts and modules used by people you will never meet is a different discipline from internal IaC \- versioning, backward compatibility, upgrade paths, and support all become your problem.
  
  

You have real security depth. You can lead a security architecture conversation rather than coordinate one.
  
  

You treat cloud cost as an engineering responsibility, and you can build cost models that stand up to commercial scrutiny.
  
  

You have built incident response rather than just carried the pager, and you have handled complex incidents including those involving customer infrastructure.
  
  

You are comfortable as a technical peer with senior engineers who will challenge you, and equally comfortable presenting to leadership and customers.
  
  

You write things down. We are moving deliberately from knowledge held by individuals to standards that are explicit, teachable, and enforceable.
  
  

You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you would rather define a platform than operate one that already exists.
  
  

**Nice to have:**  

Experience with single\-tenant, dedicated, or customer\-isolated deployment models \- fleet provisioning, upgrade orchestration across many instances, isolation guarantees.
  
  

Developer productivity or internal developer platform experience.
  
  

Scientific, research, or high\-performance computing environments large\-scale batch and data\-intensive workloads.
  
  

Experience with multiple cloud providers.
  
  

Release engineering experience.
  
  

Open\-source community exposure \- much of what we build is used in the open.
  
  

Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise life\-sciences customers.
  
  

Great benefits
  
  

**Time off:** 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
  
  

Equity
  
  

Private health insurance
  
  

Private life insurance
  
  

Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
  
  

Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
  
  

Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)
  
  

Location
  
  

Barcelona (Spain)
  
  

Employment Type
  
  

Full time
  
  

Department
  
  

Engineering
  
  

Nextflow, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------



The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.



We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.



Founded in 2019, we're 90\+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI\-native, and moving fast.



This is a rare chance to join a category\-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**



We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest\-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.



This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.



We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.



Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.



You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid\-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.


**What We're Looking For**


*The Essentials*


* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2\+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.


*Nice To Have*


* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day\-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.


**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**


**Equal Opportunity**



Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.



If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------



At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high\-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.



You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top\-of\-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.



We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================


Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.


You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.


Your will be responsible for a multi\-disciplinary engineering team of 20\-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


**Technical \& organisational strategy**


* Define the multi\-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost\-to\-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery \& operations**


* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group\-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, sensible on\-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**


* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade\-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**


* Represent Engineering in company\-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer\-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


* 8\+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3\+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes in product\-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade\-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================


You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI\-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.


You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on\-site rhythm agreed with your team.


As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.  

  



  

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi\-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.
  

  

For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  

  

**About our people \& culture**

  

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35\+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever\-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  

  

**About our benefits**

  

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!  

  



* Flexible on\-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!

We also offer location\-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.  

  



**Diversity \& Inclusion**


At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Project Manager (Video Ads)
description:
A freelance project manager to run video ad campaigns for B2B tech clients, from the first brief to the final file.

**About us**
------------


We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.


Have we mentioned we have a 4\-day workweek?

**The role**
------------


We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.


A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.


You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. You'll be the person who knows where every ad stands and tells us early when something slips. Most of the work is in post\-production, the rest is pre\-production and shoots.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run several video ad campaigns at the same time, from kickoff to final delivery
* Be the client's day\-to\-day contact: send scripts, cuts and updates, and run the feedback rounds
* Plan pre\-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3\+ years as a project manager, producer or post\-production coordinator on ads and campaigns, in an agency or a production company
* You know how post\-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest
* You've been the main contact for clients, and you can say no when a request doesn't fit the plan
* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish
* You live in Barcelona. Shoots and part of the team are here

**Nice to have**
----------------

* B2B tech or SaaS clients
* You've worked on AI\-generated video and you know tools like Runway or Higgsfield
* Paid social: you know what Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube need from an ad file

**How we'll work together**
---------------------------


This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full\-time on our 4\-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.


We'd like to start as soon as possible.

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


At Camping, diverse teams drive better ideas and better work. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful environment for everyone we work with.

Click\&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest\-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. By joining Click\&Boat, you’ll meet a team of talented, committed, and passionate engineers with a lot of product interactions. title: Learning Support Assistant

The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  

  

BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18\. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  

  

Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre\-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021\), as well as a brand\-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre\-University education and opened in September 2023\.

The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state\-of\-the art Pre\-University Centre (Nexus), a full\-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.

Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries \- in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East \- serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".

**Launch Strategy**


* You are accountable for driving the Global Pre\-Launch strategy and planning 12\-18 months prior to launch and providing commercial input into development programs.

* Partnering with (R\&D, Operations, Corporate Affairs, Finance, et al) and regional/local teams to develop relevant launch strategy. Additionally, working with regional colleagues to plan the market shaping activities 12\-18 months prior to launch

**Business \& Commercial Performance**:


* You are responsible for development and evolving the commercial strategy (positioning, messaging, claims, patient/HCP segmentation …etc.). in partnership with Regional Commercial leads to ensure local execution of strategy.

* You are responsible for the development, communication and evolution of long\-range global forecasts for your portfolio (LTP)

**Pipeline**:


* As the pipeline evolves, this role will also be instrumental in partnering with R\&D, BD and other enterprise functions to support Business Cases for pipeline assets to be assessed by the Leadership team

**You will need to have:**


* Bachelor’s degree in business or life sciences; a Masters degree would be supportive
* Minimum 10\+ years in pharmaceutical or biotech industry in roles encompassing strategic pre\-launch planning and launch, with global/regional/local experience and thorough understanding of the diverse requirements of Global markets
* Country and/ or above\-country leadership experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with accountability and a proven track record for delivering on business goals in a major healthcare market; PnL responsibility would be supportive
* Broad marketing and commercial experience with demonstrated success across various stages of the brand lifecycle, including pre\-launch planning, launch execution, and long\-term business planning
* Profound understanding of drug development and commercialization in rare disease
* Solid grasp of ongoing paradigm changes and future trends in healthcare commercialization
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others
* Proven experience and knowledge of a broad base of external partners and customers including patients, prescribers, payors, providers and in/out license partners.
* P\&L management experience and ability to build a financial Business Case
* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance
* Excellent communications skills across a diverse set of stakeholders (commercial, clinical, medical, etc.)

**We would prefer you to have:**


* An advanced degree (MBA, MSc or PhD) is preferred
* Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience at the Global, Regional and Local level.
* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit and strategic mindset including innovation and critical thinking with performance\-oriented drive.
* You can integrate a variety of perspectives into meaningful strategies and programs.
* You embrace curiosity, collaboration and smart risk taking as a prerequisite for joint success.
* You enthusiastically embrace the diversity of individual healthcare ecosystems as significant opportunity.
* You can relate and connect deeply with various healthcare and business markets to deliver direction and support.
* You can create and mobilize an inclusive work environment of highest integrity and quality, fostering learning, growth, teamwork, individual development and attraction of top talent.

title: Head of Client Success & Growth
description:
**Ironsail Pharma**   
**Head of Client Success \& GrowthPosition Details**

**Reports to**

Chief Commercial Officer

**Direct Report**

Provider Implementation Specialist

**Key Partners**

Account Executive, Head of Operations, Finance Lead, Marketing, Product \& Development Teams

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time Independent Contractor

**Location**

Remote / Offshore

**Schedule**

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

**Compensation**

50,000\-70,000 USD annually, based on experience and qualifications, with the opportunity to earn additional performance\-based bonuses tied to commercial and growth results.

**Compensation Note:** While the salary range is displayed in EUR for local reference, compensation will be **paid in USD at $50,000–$70,000 annually**.

***This is an independent contractor position and does not include employee benefits.***

**About Ironsail Pharma**

Ironsail Pharma is a B2B healthcare platform connecting healthcare providers and organizations with a network of pharmacy partners. Through our ImpetusOne platform, clients explore medication catalogs and pharmacy options, submit and track orders, and coordinate fulfillment across patient\-specific and direct\-to\-clinic services. Our clients include independent medical practices, med spas, wellness and weight\-management clinics, and telehealth companies. We work with prescribing providers, practice owners, clinical and administrative teams, and commercial decision\-makers.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Head of Client Success \& Growth to own Ironsail Pharma's day\-to\-day commercial client function and help build a high\-performing, accountable team.

This is a hands\-on commercial leadership role responsible for both client success and commercial growth: provider activation, client retention, reactivation, account expansion, and growth. You will combine strategic leadership with direct client involvement and operational execution.

You will directly manage the Provider Implementation Specialist, work closely with the Account Executive, and partner across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Success \& Commercial Growth**

* Own the client journey from onboarding and first order through ongoing account management, retention, reactivation, and expansion.
* Develop proactive account strategies based on client activity, value, needs, and growth potential, and pursue opportunities to increase account activity, product adoption, and overall client value.
* Lead commercial conversations about products, pharmacy options, pricing, and service needs within approved parameters.
* Identify stalled, declining, or inactive accounts and build clear plans to remove barriers and re\-engage clients.
* Partner with the Account Executive on account planning, opportunities, and expansion.

**Team Leadership \& Implementation**

* Directly manage the Provider Implementation Specialist, including priorities, workload, coaching, one\-on\-ones, follow\-through, and performance management.
* Oversee implementation from qualified handoff through onboarding, first order, and early account activity.
* Build practical playbooks, follow\-up standards, workflows, and escalation paths.
* Create clear accountability so the client function operates effectively without constant executive direction.

**CRM \& Commercial Operations**

* Own the commercial use of Pipedrive, including pipeline stages, account ownership, activities, handoffs, next steps, reporting, and useful automations.
* Drive consistent CRM adoption and maintain accurate prospect, onboarding, and active\-client records.
* Monitor overdue activities, stale opportunities, missing information, and unassigned leads.
* Partner with Operations on CRM integrations and process improvements.

**Marketing \& Client Communications**

* Partner with Marketing on lead quality, conversion feedback, campaigns, and client\-facing communications.
* Review routine Meta and Google advertising materials within approved brand and messaging guidelines.
* Help ensure website content, offers, landing pages, calls to action, and lead\-capture processes accurately reflect current capabilities.
* Oversee recurring client newsletters, including content planning, accuracy, approvals, and performance.
* Partner with Product and Development to translate confirmed software releases into clear client communications and adoption messaging.

**Growth, Client Feedback \& Performance**

* Turn commercial priorities into actionable growth initiatives with clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Collect and analyze client feedback through onboarding check\-ins, account reviews, surveys, and outreach.
* Identify recurring reasons clients stall, reduce activity, or leave, and coordinate solutions across teams.
* Monitor key commercial metrics, including lead conversion, onboarding progress, time to first order, active accounts, retention, reactivation, expansion, order activity, and revenue trends.
* Conduct weekly and monthly performance reviews and translate findings into clear actions and recommendations.

**AI\-First Environment**

Ironsail operates with an AI\-first mindset. Practical, professional use of AI is an everyday expectation of this role, not an optional skill.

You will use approved AI tools to improve:

* Client communications and account research
* Reporting and trend analysis
* CRM workflows and follow\-up
* Client segmentation and growth analysis
* Process automation and team productivity

You will also identify opportunities for useful automation and help the team adopt effective AI\-assisted workflows. AI outputs must be reviewed and verified, client and patient information must be carefully protected, and human accountability remains for all decisions and external communications.

**What We're Looking For**

* Demonstrated ownership of a B2B client success, account management, or commercial function.
* Direct people\-management experience with responsibility for team performance and accountability.
* Proven results in client retention, reactivation, expansion, account growth, or revenue growth.
* Strong commercial judgment and confidence communicating directly with clients and decision\-makers.
* Strong CRM experience, preferably Pipedrive or a comparable platform, including reporting, workflows, and team adoption.
* Demonstrated professional use of AI to improve business workflows, with specific examples of measurable impact.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Product/Development teams.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to oversee client\-facing communications.
* Comfort staying hands\-on with accounts while building and leading a growing function.

**Strongly preferred:** Experience in B2B healthcare, health technology, pharmacy services, telehealth infrastructure, provider\-facing software, med spas, or wellness.

**Working With Us**

This is a full\-time independent contractor position requiring consistent availability Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

We are looking for a leader who is comfortable taking ownership, making sound decisions within established authority, identifying opportunities proactively, and bringing well\-supported recommendations to senior leadership when additional approval is required.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: 44,035\.00€ \- 61,649\.00€ per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have at least 7 years of professional experience in B2B Client Success, Account Management, Sales, Commercial Growth, or a closely related client\-facing function, including experience owning client retention and account growth?
* Have you directly managed a Client Success, Account Management, Sales, or Implementation team, including setting priorities/KPIs, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for performance?
* Do you have hands\-on commercial or sales experience with existing clients, including identifying expansion opportunities, leading pricing or commercial conversations, and contributing directly to renewals, upsells, or revenue growth?
* Do you use AI tools professionally on a regular basis beyond basic writing—for example, for client/account analysis, CRM workflows, reporting, segmentation, automation, sales enablement, or improving operational efficiency?
* Are you comfortable working Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time as a full\-time independent contractor for $50,000–$70,000 USD annually, paid in USD, without employee benefits?

title: Global Head of Operations Excellence
description:
Galderma is the emerging pure\-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science\-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast\-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ \- the skin \- meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.  



We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.  



At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.


Further supporting our growth and innovation momentum, we are establishing a new Global Capability Center in Barcelona to deploy new capabilities to effectively support its global commercial and functional teams. Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross\-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.


**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  

  

Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world\-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end\-to\-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.  



Working with Operations functions, and their embedded excellence resources, including Supply Chain, Quality, External Supply, Industrial Development and Plant leadership, you will coordinate and prioritize the required support for the entire Industrial Operations organization and will ensure standardization, where appropriate, in liaison with the other leaders. Knowledge sharing and communication of best practices will also be a key component of this position across Galderma.  

  



**About The Role**

As Global Head of Operations Excellence, reporting to the Global Head of Operations, you will drive knowledge sharing across the organization by establishing key practitioner groups focused on continuous end to end improvements and convergence on identified best practices. By creating collaboration across departments and functions throughout the Operations organization you will ensure alignment of strategy and tactics for successful excellence implementation.  



You will be responsible for the design, development and implementation of our global lean supply and manufacturing program with the intent to establish linkage and flow, meet customer demand at lowest cost with perfect quality, consolidate rationalization and enhance organizational agility.  



You will be the primary architect and leader of our Operations Excellence Transformation and as such will work to establish programs, practices metrics and standards utilizing lean methodologies, analyze and recommend future state value stream design and also identify opportunities to improve existing practices, procedures and processes toward true north vision. You will lead and mentor leaders and multi\-functional teams to implement a standardized excellence methodology to ensure consistent and rigorous application across the business in line with best practice.  



Based in Barcelona or London, the position holder will be a member of our Operations Leadership Team, and partner closely with various department to collaborate on all aspects of the company's Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing/Procurement and Supply Chain strategies.  



**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement Galderma’s end\-to\-end Operations Excellence transformation strategy and deploy a program for lean development across our global supply, industrial and manufacturing footprint including coordination of our drive to 85% Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)
* Continuously structure, coordinate and update the Operations function annual strategy plan through a clear methodology based on the Hoshin process including dashboard accountability for all Operations functions.
* Conduct Extended Value Stream Baseline analysis, Supplier summit and Kaizen events with site and function leaders to improve performance in the identified areas requiring lean/kaizen support. Provide high level, lean master/sensei support to help build capability and ensure required event objectives are achieved. In addition to that, responsible for progressing lean continuous Improvement (CI) and lean culture penetration.
* Pilot Operations’ evaluation of performance, rationalization and agility through cross functional dashboard ownership and reporting.
* Utilize, drive and promote understanding of Lean and Six\-Sigma tools and principals to ensure the delivery of business objectives and a culture of continuous improvement; develop and implement improvement plans, facilitate daily visual management, lean conversion and root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
* Provide expertise, professional advice and guidance to the business in business improvement, drawing from proven industry practice and methodologies
* Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the Lean strategy
* Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on Lean methodologies. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimizing cost
* Effectively coach teams to manage for daily performance using visual controls
* Mentor using Gemba walks and other lead standard work toolkits.
* Coach employees to see abnormal conditions and problem solve systematically
* Lead kaizen events to bring Operations to standard, or improve work performance toward true north
* Ensure 5S/RCCA is taught, implemented and adhered throughout the organization.
Coordinate, schedule and facilitate as applicable Lean/Six Sigma activities to enhance cross\-functional problems solving; utilize Company tool champions as appropriate for more significant lean events  
* 

**About You**

* Solid experience in highly performing manufacturing structures operating at 85%\+ OEE.
* Involvement building and leading successful projects and programs with an understanding of the tactics needed for execution, including overall upskilling and upscaling of manufacturing performance.
* Ambitious, entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business
* Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage executives
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple work streams at once
* Exceptional critical thinking and ability to professionally advance others’ understanding of lean metrics and goals
* Result and customer focused with a successful record of accomplishments through skilled use of influence, persuasion, negotiation and resolution
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate projects status needs across different levels of the organization and different operating environments
* Determined focused leader; ability to quickly establish credibility throughout the organization by effectively balancing strategic as well as on\-going operations \& execution levels
* Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Relationship builder and can hold people accountable while making them feel energized about the road ahead
* Anticipate the needs of teammates, give and get all the facts making it easy for all to make decisions
Mastery is expected but not limited to JIT, takt, flow, pull, standard work sheet, Jidoka, DMAIC, A3, policy deployment, Toyota production system, TPM, continuous flow, continuous improvement, error proofing, eliminating waste, 5 why’s, heijunka, Kanban, kaizen, linearity, pacemaker, pitch, replenishment system, SWIP, supermarket, standardized work, standard work combo sheet, value stream mapping, visual management.  
* 

**Requirements**

  

* Background in manufacturing, Supply Chain and/or engineering environments within a large global organization, including site manufacturing leadership experience
* Master Black Belt in Six Sigma or equivalent qualification
* Automotive or cost oriented company experience preferred
* Background in people management, project management and digital transformation
* Qualified Trainer certification and experience would be appreciated
* Membership of an industry\-related professional body would be advantageous

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**About Janus Digital**




Janus Digital is the agentic AI platform that runs the world’s real assets, earning only on the additional value it creates. Built on 15\+ years of foundational R\&D and more than $100M invested, the platform is live across 10,000\+ building datasets in 253 cities, trusted by Fortune Global 500 companies, sovereign wealth funds and premium hospitality brands.




**About This Role**




* First marketing hire: you will be the first person in marketing at Janus Digital, and we will build the team around you. Initially you must be capable of, and willing to, carry out every aspect of marketing yourself – from strategy and positioning through content, paid media, MarTech and reporting – with a strong focus on sales enablement and AI\-native ways of working.
* Strategy and execution in one seat: you own Janus Digital’s marketing strategy end to end, setting direction, priorities and budget, and then deliver it day to day, sleeves rolled up.
* This is not a delegate\-only director role: you will run campaigns, manage the MarTech stack and execute paid media personally while you build and shape the team around you.

 **Requirements**  



**What You’ll Do**




* Own and set Janus Digital’s marketing strategy: market prioritisation, positioning, channel mix, budget allocation and annual and quarterly plans, aligned with commercial leadership.
* Define and refine Janus Digital’s commercial narrative and our outcome\-based value proposition for C\-suite economic buyers (CEOs, COOs, CFOs).
* Architect and run Account\-Based Marketing across our launch markets, Singapore and the UK, extending as we scale.
* Pioneer paid Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and chatbot advertising, alongside hands\-on paid LinkedIn and Google SEM.
* Make sales enablement a core priority: build and maintain the sales and partner toolkit – ROI calculators, pitch decks, battlecards, case studies and objection\-handling scripts – and work closely with sales to keep it sharp and in use.
* Manage LinkedIn as our priority social channel, including ghostwriting for our Global CEO and Singapore CEO.
* Deploy and independently manage a lean, AI\-native MarTech stack (Attio, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Koala, Supabase, Evidence.dev, a headless website, Cookiebot), orchestrated through Slack and Claude.
* Use AI tools and agents daily to multiply your output across research, content, campaign build, personalisation, analytics and reporting, so you can operate at the pace of a full function from day one.
* Report pipeline contribution and outcome\-based value attribution against the model agreed with commercial leadership.

  

**What We’re Looking For**




* 8–12 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, selling to C\-suite buyers through long, trust\-led cycles (not self\-serve or product\-led SaaS).
* Experience owning marketing strategy, ideally as a Head of Marketing or senior manager ready to step up, combined with the willingness to execute everything yourself – this role is genuinely hands\-on until the team is in place.
* A true builder mentality: experience as a first or early marketing hire in a scaling company, and the ambition to build a team.
* Strong, practical AI capability: confident using generative AI tools, agents and automation (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, workflow automation) to plan, create and run marketing at scale.
* Proven sales enablement experience: creating the content, tools and processes that help sales teams win complex, high\-value deals.
* Practical campaign experience across Singapore/APAC and the UK/Europe.
* Expert, hands\-on experience running Google Ads, SEM and complex LinkedIn paid architectures.
* A demonstrated history of independently rolling out CRM, automation, data and reporting stacks.
* Sharp technical and commercial editing capability, with confident ghostwriting in an executive voice.
* Exposure to institutional financial services marketing (e.g. private equity, asset management) is a strong plus; familiarity with real estate or proptech also helps, though neither is essential.

  

**Nice to Have**




* Prior exposure to paid and organic Answer Engine Optimisation.
* Exposure to partner\-led (B2B2B) go\-to\-market motions.
* A background marketing to PE, VC or institutional finance, or marketing tech/data intelligence services.

 **Benefits**  



**What We Offer**




* Full ownership of marketing strategy and delivery, and the opportunity to build and lead the team, with a defined path to CMO as the business scales.
* Genuine autonomy to shape how marketing works at Janus Digital, and to build the team around you.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in AI\-native growth methodologies, ahead of the market.
* High\-stakes global execution across Dubai, Singapore and the UK (with a progressive roadmap which encompasses much more)
