title: Director of Partnerships
description:
**Location:** London (hybrid), Cape Town (hybrid), Geneva (hybrid / remote), USA (remote \- East Coast), Global (remote)

### **Goodwall**


Goodwall (https://www.goodwall.io) is a TIME100 award\-winning social education app, empowering over 4 million youth with skills in AI, climate, and entrepreneurship through impactful experiential learning.


We deliver meaningful, authentic brand value to our partners by serving as the trusted bridge connecting Gen Z \& Alpha with Fortune 500 companies, governments, and international organisations, including Microsoft, Accenture, HP and UNICEF. Goodwall co\-builds engaging experiential learning campaigns for the next generation to help young people across the globe gain the confidence, skills, and networks to achieve better livelihoods.


Backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognised as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes.

### **About the Role**


We are looking for a **Director of Partnerships** to help take Goodwall into its next stage of growth. This is a big role in a small team: you’ll be responsible for winning new partnerships, growing relationships with major organisations, and turning ambitious ideas into high\-value programs that deliver real impact for young people.


You’ll have a multi\-million\-dollar revenue target across multiple 6\-7 figure partnerships, and will be expected to build a significant part of your own pipeline. You’ll work with senior leaders across global companies, Fortune 500 corporates, foundations and public sector organisations \- opening doors, building trust, shaping opportunities and getting contracts over the line.


But this isn’t a role where you’ll be selling a fixed product from a playbook. Goodwall is evolving quickly, and our best partnerships are built around what our partners are trying to achieve. You’ll listen, spot the opportunity, bring the right people together and work with the team to create something bespoke that works for everyone.


You’ll have a lot of autonomy. We’re a lean team, so you’ll have real influence over how we sell, who we build relationships with and where we focus. If you see a better way of doing something, we expect you to run with it. This is not a typical 9\-5 role, and we trust you to manage your time around your partnerships.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Build and close big opportunities:** Own a multi\-million\-dollar target, create your own pipeline and turn conversations into significant new partnerships.
* **Open doors:** Use your network, our existing relationships and smart outreach to build relationships with the people who can make things happen.
* **Build great partnerships:** Understand what organisations care about and find the intersection between their goals and what Goodwall can deliver.
* **Grow what’s working:** Develop existing partnerships, find new opportunities within them and build relationships that last.
* **Bring ideas to life:** Work closely with our programs, product and leadership teams to shape compelling proposals and partnerships.
* **Own the full journey:** From the first conversation through to proposal, negotiation and close, you’ll take ownership and keep things moving.
* **Help shape how we grow:** We’re still building our approach to partnerships. You’ll have a voice in where we focus, how we sell and how we build a high\-performing partnerships team.

### **Why Goodwall?**

* **Above\-market compensation package** that rewards performance
* The chance to work on strategic **6\-7 figure partnerships** with some of the world’s biggest organisations
* A genuinely global role, meeting and working across markets and with a global youth community
* A small, ambitious team where you can **shape the strategy, not just execute it**
* Real **ownership**, autonomy and room to grow
* **Flexibility** on working environment
* And most importantly, a **mission** you can be proud of \- helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures

### **What You Bring**

* **10\+ years experience** in enterprise sales, partnerships or business development, ideally selling into corporate CSR, sustainability, HR/talent or foundation budgets, in youth, skills, workforce development, edtech or social impact. Strong sellers from adjacent spaces (fintech, HR\-tech, digital health) who have sold "soft" outcomes to hard enterprise buyers are also a fit.
* You’re naturally commercial, but you’re also **curious and creative** — you know that the best opportunities often start with a conversation rather than a pitch.
* You’re **confident** **building** **relationships** with senior decision\-makers and equally comfortable getting into the **details** with the people who will actually make things happen.
* You can take an idea from **“this could be interesting” to a signed contract** — including shaping the proposal, numbers and business case.
* You’re highly **self\-directed**. You don’t need a big team or lots of processes around you to get things done.
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity, move quickly and enjoy figuring things out as you go.
* Most importantly, you want **ownership.**

title: Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: AI Transformation Coordinator
description:
We are looking for and **AI Transformation Coordinator** \- not a technical expert, but an effective communicator, automations enthusiast, who


ensures AI is adopted safely, practically and consistently across E\&C, and turns business needs into useful AI solutions.


**LOCATION**: Remote work is possible, however the E\&C’er **needs to be located** within European E\&C entities: E\&C Group Locations

**Why E\&C Consultants?**


You can read more details here: Becoming an E\&Cer, but in big lines:

* We are a **Great Place To Work®****certified** company \- employee satisfaction stamped by our staff
* We provide **Growth Opportunities \-** as E\&C continues to expand, you grow with us
* We implemented a **Flexible and Empowering Culture \-** we pioneer with our unique Teal management style, which includes **Empowerment, Ownership, Self\-Management, Integrity, Transparency** and **Trust**
* We offer **46 days off / year** (yes, 46!) regardless of the country you live \& work in
* Remote work is possible but the E\&C’er has to be located in the European E\&C entity

**Why did we decide to create such a role at E\&C?**

Most of the value in AI is not in the tools themselves. It is in the distance between having access to them and using them well, and that distance is currently being crossed unevenly and informally across the business. This role exists to close that gap deliberately: to make good practice visible and repeatable, to stop capable people from spending hours rediscovering what a colleague solved last month, and to make sure the initiatives we invest in are the ones that actually pay back. Equally, the role exists to apply judgement about where AI is *not* the answer — an honest recommendation to keep a process manual, or to solve it with a spreadsheet, a script or a conversation, is as valuable as an automation delivered.

 **What would you be trusted with if you join us?**

* **Identify and prioritize** AI use cases by working with teams to understand pain points, expected value, feasibility and data sensitivity
* **Measure and report business impact** (usage, hours returned, cycle‑time improvements, automated workflows, cost vs benefit)
* **Be a point of contact** for our E\&Cers for AI questions \& ideas
* **Design and deliver targeted training, policies \& guidance (**with the help of our amazing HR and Admin teams**)**, workshops and knowledge sessions tailored to different audiences and technical confidence levels.
* **Shape a network of AI champions** embedded across functions to sustain capability building
* **Partner with IT** to ensure AI use aligns with information security, data governance and records requirements, help mitigate risks (client confidentiality, personal data, IP, output accuracy and appropriate human oversight)

**It’s a very new role \- so, fair question: what success looks like?**


In 12 months we’d hope for:

* **Increased enthusiasm and awareness** of sensible usage of AI solutions (yes, we know, that’s not something you can really control, but we are all here to support you in making it happen!)
* A clear, **documented pathway** from idea to deployed AI solution, understood and used across the business
* **Measurable growth in active, competent use** of approved AI tools: not licences issued, but work genuinely being done differently
* A published **set of AI guidelines** that E\&Cers can find, understand and follow, aligned with our security and data governance
* A maintained **inventory of AI tools and use cases**, with costs and benefits overview
* An **active AI champions network** reducing reliance on this role as the single point of support
* **Reduced duplication across AI initiatives** \- which investments are returning value and which should stop?

 **What makes you the perfect match?**

* Not a surprising one \- we count on **deep, hands\-on fluency with current generative AI tools**, including assistants, agentic workflows and automation platforms, together with the habit of staying current as the field moves
* We do not need AI implementation experience (we know, that’s new!), but ideally in **change management**; designing and delivering training or enablement that changed how people worked afterwards
* Soft skills magic: the ability to sit with a team whose work you do not know, **break a vague "could AI do this?**" into discrete steps, and design a workflow that runs \- without needing to be the expert in their domain
* Even more on that: **facilitation skills**, and the credibility to earn the trust of sceptics and apply restraint to enthusiasts in equal measure
* **Writing skills** (and, yes, you can use AI help for that :D) \- the ability to write guidance people will actually read \& understand: also the data safety part
* **Comfort with numbers**: tracking usage and licence costs across a toolset, constructing a credible view of return, and making the case for change when the value is not there
* We remain sensible though: **the willingness to recommend against an AI solution** when a simpler approach would serve the business better is also important
* **Resilience to a moving target** \- advice given in March for example may be superseded in June and will need to be revised without defensiveness

**In essence:**


This is not a research position, and it is not a role for someone principally interested in new tools for their own sake. It is a role for someone who holds genuine enthusiasm for what these tools make possible alongside a healthy scepticism of the surrounding hype, and who takes real satisfaction in watching a colleague reach the point where they understand how to do it themselves.


Nor is it a role that succeeds from a desk. The work happens alongside the teams whose processes are changing.

**If you are still here and reading, you must be really interested.**  

Great, as E\&C is the best place to be! Last but not least then, a sneak peek into our application process:

* First call with HR or COO \- 45 min
* Assessment: online ability tests \+ personality questionnaire \- 45min
* Final round interview: Business case (can be prepared in advance) \& discussion on the online assessment \+ meeting the team \- 90min

  

The process usually takes around 2\-3 weeks. **Time to click apply!**

*Your personal data will be processed by E\&C Group BV with its registered seat in Kortrijk, Belgium and its affiliates for the purposes of the recruitment process only. The list of all affiliates may be found at www.eecc.eu.*

title: FinOps Specialist
description:
**Why Join dLocal?**  

dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest\-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60\+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300\+ teammates from 40\+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.

  

As our **FinOps Specialist**, you will be responsible for safeguarding business integrity, operational resilience, and financial precision. Acting as a strategic subject matter expert, you will oversee high\-risk transactional flows and collaborate cross\-functionally to proactively identify, mitigate, and resolve operational risks related to merchants, FX, and financial processes.  

  

You will play a key role in elevating the FinOps Specialist function into a highly standardized, automated, and data\-driven discipline. You will design and execute an assurance roadmap that leverages technology, robust control frameworks, and best practices to drive operational excellence, scalability, and governance.
### **What will you be doing?**



* **Oversight \& Assurance:** Serving as a senior regional authority to establish, monitor, and enforce robust business assurance frameworks across regional markets and operations.
* **Process \& Control Transformation:** Designing and executing a process transformation roadmap to simplify, standardize, and automate complex fx reconciliations, controls, and risk\-monitoring mechanisms.
* **Digitalization \& Automation:** Identifying operational gaps and manual vulnerabilities (e.g., in reconciliations, FX monitoring, merchant settlements) and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance teams to implement sustainable, automated, and scalable solutions.
* **Issue Governance \& Structural Fixes:** Driving root\-cause analysis on operational differences, control deficiencies, and transactional anomalies; ensuring cross\-functional execution of corrective and preventive action plans to achieve long\-term structural fixes.
* **Cross\-Functional Influence \& Alignment:** Collaborating strategically with regional and global stakeholders (Finance, Treasury, Commercial, Product, Tech, and Compliance) to align priorities, mitigate operational exposure, and streamline workflows.
* **Continuous Improvement \& Risk Analytics:** Establishing continuous monitoring mechanisms through key metrics, automated dashboards, and regular assurance reviews to provide visibility to executive leadership.
### **What skills do I need?**


* High attention to detail, well organize and excellent analytical skills.
* 2\+ years of experience in Projects, QA testing, internal/external auditing, reconciliations, or multinational companies.
* Ability to manipulate large amounts of data. Experience with Simetrik would be a plus
* Ability to adapt to change quickly and multi\-task.
* Enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and confident.
* **Fluent written and spoken English.**
* Solid experience with **SQL and BI tools** (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) to query, analyze, and build automated assurance dashboards.
* **Applied AI \& Automation Skills:** Practical experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., LLMs, Generative AI, or machine learning frameworks) and prompt engineering to accelerate data analysis, automate anomaly detection, enhance risk identification, and streamline core assurance workflows.


**What do we offer?**  

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:  

* **Flexibility in how you work:** We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
* **Fintech industry:** work in a dynamic and ever\-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.


\- **Referral bonus program:** our internal talents are the best recruiters \- refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.  

* **Work From Anywhere:** Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.
  



**What happens after you apply?**
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Application Security Engineer

* Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.

* Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
* Hands\-on penetration testing experience.
* Experience securing LLM\-powered or AI products.
* Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
* Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

  

Brand:
  

Nebius Academy  

  

What you will do:
  

* Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow\-up.
* Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
* Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
* Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
* Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk\-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
* Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
* Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
* Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day\-to\-day work.
* Address security risks specific to AI and LLM\-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

  

What we can offer you:
  

* A supportive and proactive work environment.
* Competitive compensation: 4000\-6000 EUR Gross per month
* Fully remote and full\-time collaboration.
* Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
* Tangible results measured by student success.

title: Human-AI Interaction Researcher
description:
**Company Description**  

Meet Unit4\. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid\-market people\-centric organisations.


With our innovative, self\-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high\-value work.


At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: **Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters.** — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.


We’re shaping **how work should feel**, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need \- it's what makes us unique.

 **Job Description** *A research position in Unit4 CTO, joining the team in Labs. You will work on how people and AI agents work together, so the systems agents operate stay understandable, trustworthy, and useful to the people they serve.*

**About the role**


Enterprise software has always been an information system. For most of its history it was an information system built for people to operate directly. People read the screens, entered the data, and moved work through the steps the system laid out. The data meant something and the process meant something, but that meaning lived in the heads of the people using the system and in the code underneath it, never in a form the system itself could reason about.


That is changing now that meaning can be made explicit, so the system represents it, something else can read and act on it, and that something is increasingly an agent. The information system is becoming one that agents operate, in service of the people it has always been for. As the burden of reading the system, traversing it, and acting through it moves onto the software, the person's part changes. They author intent and judge outcomes rather than traverse machinery. How that relationship should work, how an agent should communicate, how it earns and keeps trust, and what it does to the way people think, decide, and work, are open questions. This role works on exactly that.

**What already exists**


Our AI First program has built a layered architecture in which meaning sits between the raw data and the agents that reason over it, a semantic data model and a semantic business process model, with metadata pipelines, data contracts, a catalog, and an ontology graph delivered as a proven proof of concept and now moving toward delivery. Agents already answer business questions over this layer. What we do not yet have is a research line on the human side of that interaction. Human\-AI interaction is a new research area in Unit4 Research, and you would help define it from the start, drawing on what the program has built and on the experience of the teams taking agents into product. This is research on the relationship between people and AI, rather than product usability or customer research, though it should inform both.

**What you will work on**


This is a research role, so the questions are open, but the starting problems are concrete.

* Define and run the research agenda for human\-AI interaction at Unit4, setting its priorities together with the program.
* Study how AI should interact and communicate with users, including how an agent presents itself, explains what it did, and signals what it is unsure of.
* Understand how trust between people and agents is built, calibrated, and lost, so people rely on an agent when they should and question it when they should not.
* Examine the cognitive and behavioral impact of AI on productivity and decision\-making in everyday enterprise work.
* Help make human\-AI collaboration safe, fair, transparent, and trustworthy, working with our responsible AI stakeholders.
* Turn findings into principles and patterns that guide future AI experiences across Unit4\.
* Build links with universities and academic institutions, and help decide whether research collaborations or interns would add value and which profiles we need.

**How the work is shared**


You would open this research area within Unit4 Research, providing subject\-matter guidance without formally managing a team. You work alongside the architecture and AI research people on the meaning layer, including the information scientists working on how meaning is represented and evaluated, where questions about how people and agents find and interpret meaning meet. You also work with the product, design, and engineering teams taking agents into delivery, and with responsible AI stakeholders.

**What we offer**

* The chance to shape a new research area from its start, inside an established program whose work is already proven and now scaling.
* A place in Unit4 Research, close to our architecture and AI research people and to the teams taking agents into product.
* A research mandate judged by whether the findings change how we design and build AI experiences across Unit4\.
* Room to build links with academia and to help shape how Unit4 collaborates with universities in this area.
* An international and multidisciplinary environment, working in English.

  

**Qualifications** **Who we are looking for**


You might currently hold a title like human\-computer interaction researcher, cognitive scientist, human factors researcher, behavioral scientist, UX researcher with a strong research focus, or have a keen interest in the topic. The label matters less than the way you think about how people and intelligent systems work together and some real experience studying it.


What we hope you bring.

* Some experience researching how people think, decide, or work with technology, from cognitive science, human\-computer interaction, human factors, psychology, or a related field.
* A solid command of research methods, qualitative and quantitative, from designing studies and experiments to drawing sound conclusions from them.
* The ability to own a research area, framing the right questions, setting priorities, and moving forward with limited guidance.
* The ability to turn academic findings into practical principles and recommendations that product and engineering teams can act on, and to explain them to people who do not share your background.
* The habit of asking what a person is actually trying to achieve, and what they need to understand, before asking how the system should respond.


What you can pick up after joining.

* The ERPx domain and the specifics of our architecture. We do not expect you to arrive knowing enterprise resource planning.
* The particulars of how large language models and agents work, if you have the depth on the human side but less exposure to the model side.


We are glad to invest in people who want to grow into this. If you have the research depth and the interest but less exposure to AI or enterprise software, we will sponsor the learning.

**Helpful, but not required**

* Research on trust, explainability, or human oversight of automated or AI systems.
* Experience studying knowledge work or decision\-making in organizational settings.
* Experience with academic collaboration, publishing, or building university partnerships.
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles or AI regulation.

  

**Additional Information** **Who we are?**


We are a people\-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high\-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.


We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

**What we offer**

* a culture built on trust and accountability \- giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
* balance \- with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
* growth opportunities \- we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
* talented colleagues, role models and mentors \- work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
* a commitment to sustainability \- with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
* a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

**Our commitment to equity**


Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents\-to\-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

* Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
* Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

*This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!*

### **Agile movers**

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260918 **Date posted** 09/30/2026
The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will provide scientific and clinical input to all aspects of late\-stage product development and AI\-assisted ways of working. This includes but is not limited to the design, delivery, and interpretation of pivotal clinical trials and of studies that further characterize the overall benefit and risk and value of products in respiratory and immunology therapeutic area (TA) in late\-stage development. In this role the scientist will seek input from the appropriate functional experts and will coordinate these activities in support of clinical studies and programs.


The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will work to ensure that the safety evaluation process for phase II/III trials is seamless and complete, and develop and deploy AI solutions to assist this aim.


The objectives of the Global Development Scientist will be set by the Global Clinical Program Lead (GCPL) in agreement with Global Clinical Head (GCH).


The role will have a special focus on late\-stage clinical trials within the Respiratory TA where the Global Development Scientist will work in close collaboration with the study team physician, sites, and other cross\-function stakeholders in Respiratory and the wider AI community with all aspects of scientific input, clinical data quality metrics and safety evaluation.


Alongside delivery of the role’s established scientific and clinical responsibilities, the Global Development Scientist will act as a lead for selected AI\-enabled use cases—identifying high\-value opportunities, translating clinical needs into clear requirements, piloting solutions in live studies, piloting and evaluating workflows, and supporting adoption at scale.


A key purpose of the role is to support the deployment of AI\-assisted methods that maintain/enhance quality whilst accelerating the design, conduct, data review and interpretation; ensuring the retention of accountable human scientific and clinical judgement and analysis of clinical trials. Always ensuring that the novel AI solutions deployed follow appropriate governance processes and maintain the standards of Good Clinical Practice (GCP). All of this with the ultimate goal of helping to bring new treatments to patients.


The role will connect clinical domain expertise with AI capabilities. It will help establish reusable approaches rather than isolated pilots, with success assessed through evidence of adoption and measurable improvements in clinical development outcomes, quality, efficiency or cycle time.


You will be expected to collaborate effectively with colleagues in late\-stage Respiratory groups, and to build productive connections. The first AI features ship this autumn with design partners. You take it from there. Core tracking has its own owner \- you build the AI layer on top.


We set the direction. Every decision inside the AI track is yours. Success is how many customers use AI every week \- not how many agents we ship.


**About Scaleo**

Scaleo powers affiliate programs for iGaming operators and networks globally, with customers across Europe, the UK, the US, Asia and Australia. A lean team of \~40, heading towards an AI\-native partnership platform \- AI does the heavy lifting, humans focus on strategy and relationships.

title: Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director – VFX
description:
**Company Description**  

Built on legacy. Driven by what’s next.


At El Ranchito, our work comes to life through the unique talent, creativity, and imagination of our people. From our studios in Madrid and Barcelona, we bring some of the biggest stories in film and television to screens everywhere through world\-class visual effects.


As part of the Pitch Black network, El Ranchito brings its distinctive creative expertise to a global community of studios, diverse talent, technology, resources, and possibilities.


Join us and help craft the moments audiences remember.

 **Job Description**  

El Ranchito is looking for a Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director who combines strong visual judgement with coding and applied machine\-learning skills.


Reporting to the Machine Learning Supervisor, this is a hands\-on, production\-facing role focused on using ML to solve real VFX challenges. The position sits between artistry, pipeline development and applied machine learning: understanding how high\-quality visual effects are created while having the technical ability to build, adapt and troubleshoot the tools behind them.


This is not a role focused solely on generating images with existing tools. We are looking for someone who can understand a production problem, investigate possible technical solutions, build or adapt a workflow, evaluate its limitations and help artists use it successfully on real work.


Candidates may come from any VFX department—including compositing, FX or Lighting. Professional experience as a production VFX artist or artist\-facing TD is strongly preferred.


Exceptional ML candidates without a traditional VFX background may also be considered if they demonstrate outstanding technical depth, strong visual judgement and highly relevant work in image, video, 3D or other areas directly applicable to VFX production.


The role is open to candidates based in Spain.

 **Qualifications**  

* Professional production experience as a VFX artist or artist\-facing TD in at least one department is strongly preferred.
* A strong reel, portfolio or body of work demonstrating visual judgement and technical problem\-solving.
* Practical experience applying machine learning, computer vision or generative models to image, video, geometry or related media.
* Strong Python skills and experience creating maintainable production tools.
* Familiarity with Git, APIs, package and environment management, and reproducible development practices.
* Experience with an ML framework such as PyTorch or equivalent.
* A working understanding of model inference, datasets, evaluation, fine\-tuning and GPU\-based processing.
* Experience integrating tools into at least one major VFX application or production pipeline is highly valued.
* A solid understanding of production imagery, including colour, dynamic range, resolution, compositing requirements and temporal consistency.
* Strong visual judgement and the ability to respond constructively to creative direction.
* A generalist mindset and the ability to move comfortably between creative, technical and pipeline challenges.
* The ability to explain technical ideas and limitations clearly to artists, supervisors and production teams.
* Full professional fluency in spoken and written English, with confidence collaborating across international teams and time zones.
* Candidates must be based within the European Union for the duration of the role. Spain is preferred but not essential.


Candidates without a traditional VFX background may still be considered if they demonstrate an exceptional track record in relevant applied ML work, together with a strong visual portfolio and a clear understanding of the quality and control required for professional image production.

**Valuable Additional Experience**

* Nuke, Houdini, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine or other VFX and DCC applications.
* ComfyUI or other node\-based ML workflow systems.
* OpenCV, Diffusers or related computer\-vision and generative\-media frameworks.
* C\+\+, CUDA or model and inference optimisation.
* Linux, containers, cloud or render\-farm infrastructure.
* USD, OpenColorIO, ACES, EXR and high\-dynamic\-range image workflows.
* Segmentation, matting, tracking, depth estimation, reconstruction, inpainting, relighting, denoising or upscaling.
* Video generation, optical flow and temporal consistency techniques.
* Dataset preparation, model training or distributed inference.
* Artist\-facing UI or web development.
* Open\-source contributions, publications or research with a clear application to VFX production.

  

**Additional Information**  

Please include a CV, reel or portfolio, and examples of relevant technical work.


These may include code samples, open\-source contributions, tools, workflow demonstrations or concise case studies explaining the production problem, your individual contribution, the approach taken, its limitations and the final result.


We understand that production work is often confidential. Please do not share restricted material; a clear written breakdown of your role and approach is equally valuable.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience.

title: Executive Associate- [Open to Tier 0, 1 and 2 applicants]
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1:** Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated:** All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting\-edge global perspectives and advocacy.


The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi\-stakeholder fora including public\-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, South\-South and Triangular cooperation initiatives, and engages in UN inter\-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results\-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts in close coordination and thematic synergy with the Crisis Bureau (CB).


The Front Office of BPPS is responsible for the smooth and seamless management of the substantive flow of information to and from BPPS, coordinating effective internal communications with BPPS teams, other Bureaus, the UNDP Executive Office, as well as communications with external partners. The Front Office plans and coordinates the BPPS Director and BPPS Deputy Director’s internal and external interactions and interventions based on priorities and agendas, in close collaboration with technical teams and other Bureaus as needed, ensuring the Director and Deputy Director’s successful provision of political leadership, strategic guidance, and managerial as well as programmatic priorities in full compliance with UNDP’s mandate.


With the opening of a new UNDP office in Madrid, where the BPPS Deputy Director and a number of BPPS teams will be relocating in the course of 2026, the Executive Associate will play a key role in supporting the establishment and smooth running of the new office, and its efficient interactions with the two other main BPPS locations (New York and Bonn).


**Position Purpose:**

Under the direct supervision of the BPPS Deputy Director and in coordination with their Special Assistant, the Executive Associate ensures that the Deputy Director receives the immediate administrative and operational support needed to execute their managerial functions. The incumbent works closely with both the Special Assistant and the Executive Associate of the Assistant Administrator and Director of BPPS, to strengthen coordination and complementarities in the Office of the Director and contribute toward the overall operations of the Front Office.


As one of the first points of contact with the Bureau for senior UNDP/UN staff and the full range of representatives of UNDP’s constituencies, the Executive Associate must deal with a heavy volume of requests and a wide range of highly sensitive matters under heavy time pressure.


Given the demands of protocol and interaction, often at high levels, the Executive Associate is required to perform the role with a calm demeanor under stressful circumstances, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in personal communication, knowledge of protocol, discretion and independent judgment, motivation and proactive attitude.


**The key functions of the Executive Associate are to ensure:**

* Effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Effective communications support to the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Support for effective relationship management by BPPS Directorate;
* Support the establishment and management of the new UNDP Office in Madrid

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

**1\. Ensures effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director, focusing on the achievement of the following results:**

* Coordination and maintenance of calendar of meetings and activities of the Deputy Director, including organizing meetings, confirming the Deputy Director’s participation in senior and high\-level meetings and events, drafting replies to invitations and meetings and implementing protocol procedures;
* Management of the Deputy Director’s missions and representation schedule, including travel arrangements, communications with meeting organizers/country offices on logistics; itinerary, travel requests in Quantum, follow\-up on authorization, clearances, visas, accommodation, and tickets necessary for travel;
* Ensuring compliance with respect to administrative procedures, rules, regulations and systems,;
* Use of automated office management systems for effective functioning of the Deputy Director’s office; maintenance of contact lists and rosters of high\-level partners;
* Follow up on deadlines, commitments made, actions taken and coordination of collection and submission of the reports to the Deputy Director;
* Finance/accounts management support (i.e. processing payment requests, requisitions and claims pertaining to travels and retreats/ events) to the Deputy Director and Directorate;
* Support daily management of requests for reviews, approvals and clearances by the Deputy Director via email and DocuSign;
* Coverage and backstopping for the Executive Associate to the Director during peak times and absences

**2\. Ensures effective communications support to the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Effective monitoring and screening of correspondence arriving in and/or leaving the Deputy Director’s office. Review of incoming correspondence for the Deputy Director’s attention and prioritizing of documents according to action required; review, proofreading, and editing of all correspondence for proper clearance prior to the Deputy Director’s signature;
* Presentation of proposals to the Deputy Director and/or Special Assistant to streamline office procedures between the BPPS front office and other Headquarters units;
* Drafting and preparation of correspondence, directives, comments on behalf of the Deputy Director for their signature and ensuring follow\-up as needed;; and
* Appropriate filing, including through automated filing systems, and ensuring safekeeping of confidential materials.
* Acts as secretary to meetings as requested by the Deputy Director, including drafting minutes, follow\-ups, and reporting;
* Supports liaison with local counterparts in Spain, including the front offices of local/ federal Ministry officials and other UN agencies.

**3\. Supports effective relationship management by BPPS front office, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Collaborate with the Special Assistant to the Deputy Director and broader BPPS front office in facilitating the Deputy Director’s interactions (in sensitive, political, diplomatic, and other instances) with various external partners of BPPS, such as ambassadors, donor country delegations, parliamentarians and high\-level senior officials, as well as the Administrator and his office;
* Assist the Special Assistant to the Deputy Director in the research, obtaining and analysis of background materials for the preparation of presentations, talking points, briefings, meetings, official missions and appointments;
* Assist in the preparation of public information materials and folders, as requested;
* Support the organization of BPPS events such as townhalls, retreats or workshops, both at Headquarters and off\-site; management of procurement of services, logistics, travel, visa, etc.
* Process the Deputy Director’s travel requests and post\-travel functions in UNAll, in line with UNDP POPP, including calculation of DSA entitlements and claims and ensuring the timely settlement of claims.
* Process the Deputy Director’s travel fares in coordination with the local travel service (e.g. AMEX) in advance of missions.

**4\. Supports the establishment and smooth running of the new UNDP office in Madrid, in collaboration with the BMS focal point in Madrid, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Office management, including coordinating with BMS for the necessary inventory of the Deputy Director’s office supplies and IT needs, and ensuring the readiness or usability of office/ meeting/ event spaces (e.g. good connection of video conferencing equipment for hybrid meetings);
* Orientation for BPPS colleagues relocating to Madrid in collaboration with the BMS focal point in Madrid, including advising on necessary local registrations (e.g. to obtain the TIE \[foreign ID card]), support for obtainment of UN Grounds Pass, and office security registrations;
* Act as liaison with New York and Bonn BPPS offices in order to optimize the new configuration of BPPS across three main offices;
* Act as point of contact to prepare visits from UNDP leadership, including coordinating with Headquarters on the visit programme, facilitating the necessary travel documents for visas, support to secure UN Grounds Pass where needed, and liaising with counterparts/ Ministries in Spain on logistics and the needful security protocols.
* Acts as logistics coordinator for events involving the Madrid office staff and/or premises (e.g. preparation for official meetings or events hosted in the Madrid office, procurement of services or meeting supplies etc.).

**5\. Facilitate knowledge building and management.**

* Provide sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice.
* Organize specialized training as required.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.


Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: None


**Competencies**

* **Achieve Results:** LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
* **Think Innovatively:** LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, and makes improvements
* **Learn Continuously:** LEVEL 1: Open\-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
* **Adapt with Agility:** LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
* **Act with Determination:** LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident
* **Engage and Partner:** LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
* **Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confronts discrimination

**Cross\-Functional \& Technical Competencies:**

* **Administration \& Operations\-Travel Policy and Procedures:** Knowledge of travel policy and procedures; ability to interpret travel policy, the Staff Rules, administrative circulars, and financial regulations and rules on travel\-related matters.
* **Administration \& Operations\-Events management (including retreats, trainings \& meetings):** Ability to manage events, including venue identification, accommodation, logistics, catering, transportation, and cash disbursements, etc.
* **Administration \& Operations\-UN Travel Documents:** Knowledge of the ERP regulatory frameworks and processes related to UN Travel and Expense Module Documents; ability to facilitate the issuance of UN travel documents for UNDP and provide help desk support to UNDP and other UN agencies; processing of visas, and ensuring oversight and endorsement
* **Administration \& Operations\-Off\-boarding of personnel:** Knowledge of policy and procedures on administrative on\- and off\-boarding, including necessary clearance forms for returning office equipment, office ID, UNLP, cancellation of visa issued by host country, deletion of office email and Argus profile
* **Administration \& Operations\-Utilization of Corporate Credit Card:** Ability to ensure proper use of corporate credit card for official use; knowledge of relevant policy and procedures
* **Procurement \-Procurement Management:** The ability to acquire goods, services or works from an outside external source
* **Business Direction \& Strategy\-Systems Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Education:**

* Secondary Education is required with specialized secretarial training.

OR


A University degree (bachelor’s degree) in Business or Public Administration, Economics, Political or Social Sciences will be given due consideration, but is not a requirement.


**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor´s degree) of progressively responsible administrative or programme experience is required at the national and/or international level.
* Experience using IT software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages is required.
* Experience in handling web\-based management and using ERP systems (i.e., Quantum) systems is required.
* Experience in logistics for workshops, travel arrangements, and office management is required.
* Experience conducting targeted research, analysis, and synthesis to support senior‑level decision‑making is desirable.
* Experience supporting senior leadership in a front office or similarly fast‑paced environment is desirable.
* Familiarity with the host country’s national administrative rules and processes, especially with regard to visas, travel, protocol, and other procedures that impact the Office of the Deputy Director, is an asset.
* Demonstrated experience in liaison, coordination, or maintaining professional relations with government officials, international organizations, NGOs, and/or external partners is highly desirable

**Language:**

* Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
* Working knowledge of other UN official languages is an asset.

description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35\). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best\-in\-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.  



  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.  



  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross\-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting\-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

*What if your next project didn't end up as a slide in a deck, but as technology actually running in an airport, a highway, a solar or wind power plant, or a data center?*

  

We are looking for a hands\-on technical innovation leader who can work where energy strategy becomes real infrastructure: storage, grid connection, microgrids, electrification, critical power, resilience and renewable generation. You will assess emerging technologies with rigor, shape practical use cases and lead them through testing and validation, building the evidence the business needs to decide whether to invest, scale or stop.  



  

You will join Corporate Innovation and work across Ferrovial’s businesses: Airports, Cintra, Ferrovial Energy and Digital Infrastructure. Success in the role requires strong engineering judgement, the ability to distinguish genuine breakthroughs from incremental improvements, and the credibility to engage technical and business stakeholders alike—translating complex challenges into well\-structured pilots, clear investment decisions and scalable business opportunities.  



  

This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of infrastructure by bringing cutting\-edge technologies from concept to real\-world deployment across a global leader in the sector. Experience in mission\-critical environments, including data centers, is a plus, but not essential.  



  

**Key Responsibilitie** s


* Lead energy, sustainability and resilience projects from technology identification through pilot, business case and scale\-up recommendation
* Design and run proofs of concept with business units, OEMs, engineering partners, research centers and startups — setting your own KPIs and decision gates
* Bring real engineering judgment to grid connection, electrification, storage, microgrids, critical power, energy management and renewable generation infrastructure (solar and wind plants)
* Translate complex technical options and uncertainty into clear business cases for senior leadership
* Explore emerging low\-carbon technologies — carbon capture and utilization, green molecules, hydrogen, e\-fuels, biogenic routes — and assess their real potential
Optionally contribute to projects on low\-carbon materials, embodied carbon and circularity  
* 

  

**Qualification** s


* Hold an engineering or equivalent technical degree, ideally in electrical, energy, mechanical, industrial, civil or building\-services engineering
* 8–12 years of experience in corporate innovation, technical office roles, or critical asset operations (energy, renewables, infrastructure, data centers)
* Real engineering judgment, not just strategic vision — you can defend a technical decision, not just frame one
* Relevant knowledge of energy and infrastructure systems—including grid connection, electrification, efficiency, storage, microgrids, controls, critical power or energy management—and how they interact with thermal, water and resilience requirements
* Familiarity with low\-carbon materials, carbon technologies, embodied carbon, circularity and lifecycle value, with sound judgement on when to involve Ferrovial’s specialist teams
* Ability to build effective relationships across business units and with operators, OEMs, engineering partners, startups, universities and investors, acting as a connector rather than an operational owner
* Ability to move across asset classes: what you learn on a wind farm should be useful on an airport, a highway or a data center
* A drive to see things through: you don't stop at validation — you want to see the technology scale
* Comfort working with uncertainty and with very different stakeholders — from an OEM engineer to a business director

We are not looking for a purely strategic profile without hands\-on engineering. Someone who prefers staying in day\-to\-day operations rather than pushing change forward. Someone who wants to specialize in a single asset class.


**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!


Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

* Support the VM Manager in the development and execution of Leather Goods (LG) visual merchandising, including accessory styling and window styling guideline shoots.

* 1\+ year of experience in Visual Merchandising, Retail, or Fashion.
* Strong interest in Leather Goods, fashion, arts, crafts, and design, with a good aesthetic sensibility.

* Proactive, flexible, and solutions\-oriented, with a collaborative mindset.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
* Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.
