title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**



Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.



Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*



At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. title: Hardware Industrialization Specialist
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Education Centre Director
description:
About Boundless Life

Boundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth. We provide family\-friendly accommodations, an innovative education system that travels with you, and vibrant communities of like\-minded individuals.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve rapidly expanded to eight locations across Europe, Asia, and Latin America, bringing together over 200 team members from diverse backgrounds. Our growth reflects our commitment to transforming the experience economy and making a meaningful impact on how families integrate work, education, and exploration into their lives.

At Boundless Life, we believe in the power of community and the importance of a holistic approach to education. Our programs are designed to inspire curiosity, build resilience, and nurture a global perspective. We combine a project\-based, place\-based learning with the freedom to live and learn anywhere, for families who want more than a traditional school can offer. Our Education Centres are the heart of everything we do.

Role Overview

Estepona is one of our most established and beloved locations — a flagship of what the Boundless model is. The Education Centre Director who joins here will inherit something that is already working and will be responsible for taking it further.

This is a role for a leader who can come into an existing team, earn trust quickly, raise the bar through coaching and consistency, and build on strong foundations without disrupting what is already good. You are not here to reinvent. You are here to lead, deepen, and improve.

As Education Centre Director, you are the educational leader of the location. You are responsible for how the learning happens and how it is brought to life by your team. You know your educators deeply, coach them continuously, hold high standards, and ensure every cohort delivers on the Boundless promise.You will report directly to the General Manager, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence.

This structure allows you to focus primarily on pedagogical leadership, instructional coaching, and developing your educator team, while the General Manager owns the broader location operations. The role demands someone who is energised by that scale, not overwhelmed by it.

What You'll Do

*Educator Leadership and Team Development*

* Lead, coach, and manage an established team of educators through structured 1:1s, regular classroom observations, and direct, specific feedback
* Set clear expectations for performance and conduct from day one, address gaps independently, and build individual development plans for every member of the team
* Hold a high bar consistently — this means celebrating what is working and naming what is not, without waiting for a formal review cycle
* Build and maintain a team culture that is engaged and resilient through an intense cohort calendar and a demanding daily schedule
* Contribute to hiring decisions alongside the Head of Education Excellence when the team expands or changes

*Curriculum Execution and Educational Quality*

* Ensure the Boundless curriculum is implemented consistently and with fidelity to our global methodology and standards — you do not design the curriculum, you make sure it comes to life as intended
* Ensure project\-based and place\-based learning happen on the ground, incorporating the extraordinary context of the location meaningfully and in alignment with global curriculum standards
* Observe classes regularly and give educators specific, actionable feedback that leads to real change
* Surface implementation challenges to the global education team and bring solutions alongside them

*Family Relationships*

* Serve as a trusted, visible presence for families — including those who are returning to Boundless and have high expectations of the experience
* Handle family concerns and escalations independently and with confidence, without unnecessary escalation to global leadership
* Contribute to a strong admissions and intake experience that sets every cohort up well

*Running the Education Centre*

* Lead the essential day\-to\-day running of the Education Centre in close partnership with the General Manager and central teams.
* Own educator administration, family communication, safeguarding, and the smooth delivery of ECAs and field trips.
* Support local partners, systems and practical centre needs where required, while keeping educational leadership and people development as the priority.
* You will be involved in the Boundless Summer Camp cohorts, maintaining the same standards of team leadership and family experience.

Role Requirements

* You have meaningful leadership experience and have directly supervised, coached and developed a team of 8 \- 10\+ staff. Ideally, you will have led a microschool or similarly hands\-on learning environment that requires a holistic view of people, pedagogy, families and day\-to\-day delivery.
* Experience in excellent curriculum execution.
* You can observe a learning environment, see clearly what is and is not working, and give an educator specific and honest feedback. You understand PBL and place\-based learning as practices, not just frameworks.
* Proven experience in delivering high quality customer experiences. *You are exceptional with families.* The location has returning families who love this community. You can hold difficult conversations, manage high expectations, and maintain trust even when something has gone wrong.

You'll Also Be Valued For

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit: resourceful, proactive and comfortable building solutions in a fast\-moving environment without waiting for a complete playbook.
* You are aligned with non\-traditional education and understand project\-based and experiential learning in practice, not only in theory.
* *You are a people developer.* You have managed a team, conducted observations and given specific feedback, had hard performance conversations independently, and genuinely made the people around you better. Coaching your team is not a task on your list — it is the work.
* *You earn trust in established environments.* You do not arrive and immediately try to change everything. You listen first, build credibility, and lead from within the culture — while still being willing to raise the bar and name what needs to improve.
* *You are energised by scale and intensity.* Sixty to seventy students, an international team, a packed cohort calendar, and a community of families who are living and working alongside each other. This is the environment you thrive in.
* *Spanish language skills or a connection to Spain are a genuine asset for this role.*

What Success Looks Like

In three months: you have earned the trust of the team, completed a full round of classroom observations, every educator is clear on what is expected of them, and families feel the leadership of the EC is strong and present.

In the long term, success in this role is measured against three things:

* 85% or more of families report satisfaction with their overall Boundless Education experience, measured through our termly NPS and satisfaction survey
* 85% or more of educators and facilitators in the centre meet or exceed their role\-specific impact metrics
* Staff turnover is low and staff engagement is high, with 80% or more of the team reporting high engagement in our termly pulse survey

Who You'll Work With

You report to the location General Manager, who owns location operations, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence, who leads educational quality and development across all Boundless locations globally.

Why Join Us

Estepona is one of Boundless Life's flagship locations: with its all year round appeal, it has a strong and returning family community, and a team that cares deeply about the work. You will have real responsibility, real autonomy, a platform that is already performing well and the chance to make it even better.

Beyond the work itself, joining Boundless means being part of a mission\-driven team that genuinely believes education can be done differently. You will be part of a model that does not exist at scale anywhere else in the world — place\-based, project\-driven, and designed for families who have chosen a different kind of life. That is not a small thing to be part of.

You will also benefit from:

* A discount on Boundless Education tuition for your own children
* A global community of educators, families, and team members who care deeply about what they are building
* Real ownership of your location and your team's development
* The chance to grow as the organisation grows — this role has significant room to evolve

What to Expect Next1\. Interview with our recruiter — initial alignment on experience, motivation and role non\-negotiables (30 min)

2\. Personality assessment

3\. Panel interview with the COO \& the Head of Education Excellence (60 min)

4\. On\-site evaluation for established locations where applicable.

5\. References — structured conversations with people who have seen you manage and lead

*The process might change slightly as we go along, we will keep you posted at all times.*

Want to Know More? boundless.life

**About Frontiers**


At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.


We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open\-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer\-reviewed and quality\-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real\-world impact of science without barriers.


Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission\-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**


We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post\-production, creating interviews, talking\-head content, b\-roll, and studio shoots for company\-wide communications and campaigns.


As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.


You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high\-quality visual content in a fast\-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.


You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI\-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post\-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end\-to\-end, including scheduling interviews, talking\-head sessions, b\-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on\-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking\-heads, b\-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi\-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on\-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file\-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post\-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI\-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high\-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post\-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post\-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high\-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post\-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on\-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions\-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  

**Benefits**

* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal \& financial support)

With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

The successful candidate will play a key role in developing innovative water treatment solutions, preparing process designs and technical proposals, and supporting project execution activities throughout the project lifecycle. The position requires close collaboration with commercial, engineering, operations and customer teams to deliver reliable, sustainable and cost\-effective solutions for strategic Global High Tech customers.

 **How you'll make an impact:**

* Development of Global High Tech (GHT) opportunities: partners with Senior Design Engineer to provide project engineering support by developing mass balance, process flow sheets, preparing proposals \& estimates (CAPEX/OPEX), providing the technical/commercial support at meetings with clients.
* Process Engineering and Project Support: Provide process engineering expertise throughout the project lifecycle, supporting the development of innovative water and wastewater treatment solutions for high\-tech industries. Work closely with project managers, engineering teams and suppliers to ensure technical requirements are successfully translated into project execution, commissioning and start\-up activities.
* Support O\&M (Operation Maintenance) team for troubleshooting and continuous improvement implementation in exiting GHT contracts.
* Ability to build long\-term relationships with internal and external customers by understanding their key business drivers. High emotional intelligence level is required for this position.

 **Qualifications:**

* Education: Chemical / Environmental / Mechanical Engineering Degree
* **Minimum 3** years experience with the design and supporting the sale of water and/or wastewater equipment and systems, including clarification, filtration, membrane separation, RO/UF, DAF, solids separation, metals, removal and biological, to industrial clients.
* Experience supporting project execution, commissioning, start\-up or delivery of industrial process projects is preferred.
* Having familiarity with water treatment plant commissioning and start\-up
* Communication skills: **English** \& **French/Spanish** fluent written and verbal
* People relating attitude and capable to work in team
* Strong commercial mindset and financial acumen
* Synthesis and pragmatic approach
* Able to manage conflict and job\-related pressure
* Problem\-solving skills
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% of time to perform proper discovery and developing the cost basis for each project and present proposed solutions.
* High computer application literacy (including Microsoft Office suite, and ability to learn business systems) . Autocad preferred.

 **Principal Accountabilities**

* Functionally report in the Commercial Engineering organization to the GHT Engineering Manager.
* Based in **France or Spain** and have regular contact with his/her direct supervisor.
* Be competent in a wide range of water treatment process technologies and have proven knowledge of designing water treatment systems (prepare mass balance, flow sheet, water mapping, select equipment and costing, prepare documents to support commercial discussion)
* Be familiar with engineering drawings (P\&ID, General Arrangement, Isometric sketches, data sheets, troubleshooting list, electrical and automation drawings, etc..).
* Be able to analyze water and wastewater systems from a mechanical, operational and chemical standpoint and propose solutions that comply with customer needs and the regulatory framework.
* Proactively works with clients and Ecolab/Nalco colleagues to determine project needs and identify customer needs by evaluating business models specific to their wastewater and pretreatment operations and develop project specifications.
* Supervise and/or take over on site survey, conception and basic design by making sure the best technical and economical compromise is reached between OPEX and CAPEX.
* Utilize technical expertise and financial acumen to support projects qualification and wisely use own time and resources on projects with the highest probability of success.
* On a project base, make sure to fit with the available budget for each part of the project, and able to discuss with Peers/Manager in case of any problem rising (engineering, partners, and fabricants) during the project execution and improve construction methods.
* Be able to communicate with many levels of personnel with Nalco Company and external (i.e. Customer, Contractors).
* Have had experience, even if limited, with plant operation \& maintenance.
* Maintain customer relationships and coordinate to address technical/business issues and renewals within sold O\&M accounts.
* Assist on existing OM contracts for troubleshooting and diagnostic and Improvements identification
* Be aware of most used international standards and norms required for equipment construction and certification.
* Be aware of Safety \& Environmental aspects of legislation.

 **About Ecolab:**


At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent\-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science\-based solutions, data\-driven insights and world\-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. title: CRM and Lifecycle Manager
location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
description:
### **About us**


INDIBA Group is a global medical device organization specialised in Radiofrequency and Laser solutions for the physiotherapy, aesthetic and veterinary markets, and is internationally recognized for its scientific research carried out over the last 40 years.


At INDIBA, we believe we can contribute to the health and well\-being of people and animals by addressing new and growing needs, offering innovative treatments that allow individuals to maintain their lifestyle at an older age.

**Revitalizing lives** is what we do and what our teams work on every day.

### **What are we looking for?**


At INDIBA, the customer lifecycle runs from the first contact with a lead, through the sale of the device, onboarding and first training, to the regular purchase of consumables, ongoing training in new protocols, technical service and, years later, the renewal of the device. We want every one of these moments to deliver a consistent, excellent experience, whoever the customer interacts with.


INDIBA is seeking a **CRM \& Lifecycle Manager** to own HubSpot as the system that supports this entire lifecycle: how leads are captured and converted into sales, how customers are onboarded and kept active, and how every team works from the same customer record.


This is a new role. During the first year, the focus will primarily be on data, integrations and processes, establishing the foundations for a unified customer view. From there, the role will increasingly focus on automating, personalizing and continuously improving the customer journey.

### **What you’ll do?**

* Own and govern the global CRM, including the HubSpot data model, lifecycle stages, properties, custom objects, lists, workflows, pipelines and reporting.
* Review and optimize lead management from capture to sale, including lead qualification, scoring, routing, nurturing and follow\-up processes.
* Review and improve Sales pipelines, defining stages, entry and exit criteria, required information and automated tasks to improve conversion and forecasting reliability.
* Build and maintain unified Customer 360 profiles across all customer touchpoints, bringing together customer, device, order, training, service and interaction data.
* Co\-lead CRM integrations with IT and external partners, particularly HubSpot–Microsoft Dynamics, as well as integrations with the website, eCommerce, LMS, My INDIBA App and other tools.
* Design and maintain dynamic, behaviour\-driven customer segmentation based on customer profile, devices owned, purchase history, training status, engagement, value and churn risk.
* Design, launch and optimize automated, personalized customer journeys across different channels, including email, WhatsApp, phone calls, sales alerts, messaging channels and the My INDIBA App.
* Support B2B eCommerce and lifecycle initiatives, including segmented promotional campaigns, personalized recommendations, repeat\-purchase and replenishment workflows, abandoned carts, cross\-sell/upsell and re\-engagement.
* Work with Sales, Customer Service, Technical Service and Training to define customer experience standards, handovers, service levels, automated actions, tasks and alerts throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Ensure high data quality and governance through clear ownership, naming conventions, validation rules, regular audits and deduplication processes, while managing customer consent and communication preferences.
* Measure customer experience and commercial performance through CRM dashboards and reporting, including lead funnel, pipeline, campaign performance, active and at\-risk customers, repurchase, recurring revenue, service KPIs, NPS and customer satisfaction.
* Act as the central HubSpot point of contact across the organization, driving user adoption, training teams, maintaining documentation and owning the CRM roadmap and continuous improvement priorities.

### **What you’ll bring**

* 5\+ years of experience in CRM, marketing automation, or marketing and sales operations, including at least 3 years owning or administering a HubSpot portal.
* Advanced hands\-on HubSpot experience, including properties, custom objects, lists, workflows, pipelines, automation and reporting.
* Proven experience designing or improving lead management processes, including lead capture, scoring, routing, nurturing and sales pipeline management.
* Experience building automated and personalized customer journeys across multiple channels, with measurable impact on conversion, engagement, retention or repeat purchases.
* Strong understanding of customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization and customer experience.
* Experience working with sales, customer, order and invoicing data, with strong Excel skills and a data\-driven mindset.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Training and IT teams in a B2B environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a rigorous approach to CRM data quality and governance.
* Ability to translate business requirements into CRM processes and technical configurations.
* Fluent Spanish and English, both spoken and written.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience implementing a CRM–ERP integration, ideally HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in businesses with recurring sales from an installed customer base, such as medical, aesthetic, dental or laboratory equipment.
* Experience with HubSpot Service Hub and Operations Hub.
* Knowledge of customer experience methodologies, including journey mapping, NPS, CSAT and Voice of the Customer.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, cohort or retention analysis.
* Experience with B2B eCommerce and mobile app marketing.
* HubSpot certifications.
* Knowledge of GDPR and consent management in an international B2B environment.

### **What we offer (besides having fun while working hard)**

* Permanent, full\-time position.
* Attractive compensation package aligned with experience.
* Fringe benefits (meal vouchers/flexible compensation, wellbeing program, etc.).
* An international role in a dynamic, innovative and multinational environment.
* A new role with direct impact on the business and visible support from management.
* Ongoing product training and professional development.
* A collaborative, cross\-functional environment with exposure to different teams and markets.

title: Head of Customer Operations - Service, Engagement & Claims
description:
Company Description
  
MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology\-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer\-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.


We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.


  
Job Description
  
He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI\-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.


The role covers the customer\-facing layer of the end\-to\-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self\-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for customer service, engagement and claims across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow
* Translate customer and regulatory objectives into clear service processes, procedures, service levels and quality standards
* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self\-service portal
* Build the ticketing operation: taxonomy, routing and prioritisation rules, SLA framework, escalation paths, and shift and capacity planning
* Design proactive lifecycle communications: onboarding, first\-bill explanation, consumption and tariff alerts, renewal and price\-change notifications, and payment reminders
* Own the service side of retention — save flows, churn\-signal detection and the operational response to them.
* Build the claims process end to end
* Ensure compliance with statutory response deadlines and the formal complaint framework, including complaint forms, consumer arbitration boards and regional consumer authorities
* Act as business owner for the support stack — CRM and ticketing, telephony/CCaaS, knowledge base, survey and QA tooling: define functional requirements, target design and evaluation criteria, support the IT organisation in vendor and partner selection, and drive business validation before go\-live
* Hire, structure and lead the customer operations team; define roles, career paths, training curriculum and onboarding
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the support chain
* Collaborate across Growth, Offering, Operations and Finance on the business side, and Product, UX, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side

  
Qualifications
  
* University degree
* **Energy retail background is a must**
* Between 5 and 10 years of experience in customer operations, service management or contact centre leadership in a B2C environment, including hands\-on responsibility for building or substantially rebuilding a service function
* Experience in the Spanish market, with a working understanding of Spanish consumer protection obligations and the formal complaints and arbitration framework
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch, including defining the requirements for the supporting tooling
* Demonstrable, practical experience applying AI in a customer support context
* Comfortable in a CRM or ticketing environment, able to read data models, define integration requirements at functional level and build reporting
* Track record of leading, growing and developing teams
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Experience specifying and rolling out a support stack as business owner (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Freshdesk, Intercom, Genesys, Talkdesk or similar) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a high\-volume regulated B2C environment — utilities, telecommunications, insurance, financial services or e\-commerce — is highly appreciated
* Experience managing BPO partners in Spain or nearshore, and workforce management or forecasting experience, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

  
Additional Information

title: X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
**X\-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher**
======================================


Reference
2026\-IMPRESS\-1
Deadline
15/11/2026
Division
Experiments
#### **Institution**


ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges.


Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage.


Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions.


Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life\-work balance.


Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories.


For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video:


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=gHMqiH4qBAo


#### **Tasks**


This postdoctoral position is dedicated to scientific and technical methods for correlative operando X\-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and (Scanning) Transmission Electron Microscopy (S)TEM within the frame of the IMPRESS project (Interoperable electron Microscopy Platform for advanced RESearch and Services), funded by HORIZON\-INFRA\-2022\-TECH\-01\-01\.


The IMPRESS project aims to develop an interoperable platform based on a modular and standardized cartridge concept. The cartridges are designed to be inserted into TEM specimen and aperture holders, as well as other instruments for preparation and characterization, including surface science tools, transport measurements, microfocus X\-ray tomography instruments, and synchrotrons. Within IMPRESS, ALBA is involved in the development of a MEMS\-based micro\-reactor for correlative photocatalytic experiments in TEM and synchrotron beamlines for CO2 reduction reaction and generation of high value products.


The selected person will report to the Interdisciplinary and Multimodal Section Head and will work in close synergy with the Interface X\-ray/TEM and Methodology groups, with beamline scientists, the Joint Electron Microscopy Center at ALBA (JEMCA), and with the project partners. The role emphasis is on the testing of the microreactor prototypes in the (S)TEM and x\-ray beamlines.


Specifically, the responsibilities will include:


• Executing the commissioning, operation and maintenance of micro\-cell reactor systems for catalysis research.


* Contributing to define procedures for operando and in\-situ correlative (S)TEM/X\-ray analysis services within a network of experts and under consideration of the international community.


* Contributing to the improvement of the micro\-cell reactor system and the development of a true multi\-technique approach that will benefit staff, collaborators, and external users.


* Supporting staff and collaborators in (S)TEM and x\-ray experiments making use of the micro\-cell reactor systems.


* Analysing and interpreting multimodal experimental data.


* Disseminating results through peer\-reviewed publications, conference contributions, project deliverables and reports.

  

#### **Requirements**


The requirements for participation must be met on the date of the deadline for the submission of applications and will be accredited by means of the CV attached to it, without prejudice to the power of the selection body to require the contribution of the originals of the certifications accrediting the qualifications, training and work experience invoked in the CV.


Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted.


Candidates must hold a PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or equivalent, and have hands\-on experience in (S)TEM and/or synchrotron X\-ray techniques.


Everyone who meets the requirements will be admitted for the selection process. This position is reserved for those candidates having the legal status of person with disabilities, with a degree of disability equal or greater than 33%. In case of one or more admitted applicants with this status of disability, these candidates will be evaluated at first. In the event that no candidate with the status of disability is finally selected for the position, the selection process shall continue and the rest of the applicants will be evaluated.

  

#### **Selection Process Development**


The selection will be carried out through the competition\-opposition system.


As a first phase, an analysis of the curriculum will be carried out (assessment of previous experience and / or scientific history, degree, training and other professional information relevant to the position). Career breaks or variations in the chronological order of CVs will be regarded as an evolution of a career, and consequently, as a contribution to the professional development.


The assessment of the CV in the competition phase will be scored up to 40 points, which will consider the following aspects:


* Hands\-on experience with in situ (S)TEM \- up to 10 points.
* Hands\-on experience with in situ synchrotron experiments \- up to 10 points.
* Experience in developing and testing scientific instrumentation (reaction cells, gas delivery systems, illumination systems, strain cells...) – up to 10 pts.
* Scientific experience in x\-ray/(S)TEM correlative experiments – up to 5 pts.
* Hands\-on experience with advanced (S)TEM) techniques (e.g.: 4D\-STEM, EDX/EELS, e\-tomography, e\-ptychography, …) and/or advanced correlative data analysis – up to 5 pts.

The best rated candidates, at least two if possible, will be invited to an interview where the technical competence, knowledge, skills and professional experience linked to the position will be assessed, with a total score of 60 points. A minimum of 30 points must be obtained out of a total of 60 points to be eligible.


Provided they meet the minimum requirements and have ranked among the top five after the assessment of the CV phase, at least one person from the underrepresented gender in the division/office will be interviewed.


The interview will include at least:


* Presentation of professional experience and capability to independently design and execute advanced scientific experiments \- up to 20 points.
* Soft skills, capability to work in a team \- up to 10 points.
* Capability to develop innovative methodologies \- up to 10 points.
* Communication and coordination skills \- up to 10 points.
* Vision of the job position and motivation for applying \- up to 10 points.

The merits will be accredited by means of the CV attached to the application. The selection board may require accreditation by additional documentation, originals or certified copies confirming the experience invoked in the CV.


In case of a tied final score, the position will be awarded to the person who belongs to the most underrepresented gender in the corresponding Division and subsidiarily to the overall company.


If necessary, alternates of the members of the selection board will be appointed by the president of the selection process, and the change will be published in the announcement.


The resolution of the selection procedure will be carried out within a maximum period of six months from the deadline for submitting applications for participation.


The selection process may be declared vacant if the selection board considers not to have found eligible candidates for the position although they might meet the requirements to participate in the selection process specified in the offer.


#### **Other information**


Temporary contract linked to the HORIZON\-INFRA\-2022\-TECH\-01\-01 IMPRESS project.


Base salary range €39,350 – €42,982 gross per year.


The base salary offered will be determined according to the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant professional experience, competencies and overall suitability for the position.


ALBA also offers an attractive employment conditions, including flexible working arrangements and professional development opportunities.


The Selection Board is composed by the following members: Núria Bagués Salguero, Antoni García de Herreros Dunyac, Joaquín Otón Pérez, Lucía Aballe Aramburu.

* Build and lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary organisation.
* Recruit key executives, managers and specialist talent as the company develops.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Establish effective management processes and appropriate corporate governance.
* Develop a culture combining entrepreneurial agility with professional execution.

* Develop senior\-level relationships across the digital media, technology, creative and cultural ecosystems.
* Identify and negotiate strategic commercial and technology partnerships.
* Explore opportunities for distribution, content, licensing and international collaboration.
* Build relationships capable of accelerating market access and business development.
* Represent the company with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to transform an ambitious strategic vision into a scalable international business :

* Significant experience as a **CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Founder, senior COO** or comparable executive leader.
* Ideally **7\+ years of senior management or leadership experience**.
* Demonstrated responsibility for business strategy, financial performance and operational execution.

* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial reporting.

title: Children's Trauma and Bereavement Service Manager - Bedfordshire
description:
**Children's Trauma \& Bereavement Service Manager (Bedfordshire \& Luton)**

**Are you a qualified, bereavement\- and trauma\-trained therapist ready to lead a team that helps children reclaim their childhood after loss or a frightening event?**

An exciting opportunity has arisen at CHUMS to lead our Bedfordshire and Luton Children's Trauma and Bereavement Service. You will bring together two of our longest\-standing specialist services: evidence\-based trauma therapy for children and young people who have experienced a single traumatic event or traumatic bereavement, and our community bereavement programme for children, young people and their families.

This role is ideal for an experienced clinician who wants to step up into service leadership, or an established manager who wants to keep a hand in direct clinical work within a passionate, employee\-owned organisation.

About the service

CHUMS has supported bereaved children and young people across Bedfordshire and Luton for nearly 30 years. The service you will lead has two strands:

* **Trauma Service** – NICE\-informed, trauma\-focused therapy for children and young people aged 5–18 who have experienced a single traumatic event (such as a road traffic accident, medical emergency, fire, assault or witnessing a distressing event) or a traumatic bereavement (sudden, accidental, violent or suicide\-related death). We offer 1:1 therapy (6–12 sessions) using approaches such as TF\-CBT and EMDR, 6\-session structured group programmes, and consultation and liaison with families, schools and professionals.
* **Bereavement Service** – community\-based therapeutic support for children and young people aged 6–18 and their parents and carers. Families are assessed by a CHUMS therapist and invited to an annual programme of monthly creative, nature\-inspired family workshops that follow the rhythm of the year, with individual support for those unable to access a group.

We work as part of a "team around the child" alongside CAMHS, Early Help, schools and local support organisations, and our Children and Young People and Parent and Carer Participation Forums help shape everything we do.

Key responsibilities

* Lead, line manage and clinically support a team of therapists, practitioners, volunteers and trainees on placement
* Oversee referral management, triage and assessment, ensuring eligibility criteria and risk assessment are applied consistently
* Ensure the safe, high\-quality delivery of trauma\-focused 1:1 and group interventions and the family bereavement workshop programme
* Hold a small clinical caseload of trauma and/or bereavement work (flexible to your accreditation requirements)
* Lead on safeguarding and clinical risk within the service, supporting staff with escalation to Social Care and CAMHS
* Provide consultation, advice and training to schools and other professionals supporting bereaved and traumatised children, including our new RSHE bereavement training for education settings
* Monitor routine outcome measures and produce quarterly and annual reports for commissioners and funders
* Embed service user participation and co\-production in service design and delivery
* Build strong partnerships across Bedford Borough, Central Bedfordshire and Luton, and contribute to service development and bids

About you

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

* A qualified and experienced therapist, registered with a professional body (e.g. HCPC, BACP, UKCP, BABCP)
* Trained in trauma\-focused therapy (e.g. TF\-CBT or EMDR) and in bereavement and grief work with children and young people
* Experienced in delivering both individual and group therapy for children, young people and families
* Knowledgeable about clinical risk and safeguarding, with a strong, evidenced track record
* Experienced in, or ready to develop, supervising and managing staff and volunteers
* Confident working in multi\-agency settings and delivering consultation and training to professionals
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and write clear reports
* A car driver, able to travel across Bedfordshire and Luton

What we offer

You'll join a supportive, employee\-owned social enterprise that works to our ACE values: **Accessible, Compassionate, Effective**. In return we offer:

* **Flexible working** – ideal for those balancing childcare or other commitments
* **Supportive leadership** – direct support from our Clinical and Associate Clinical Directors, and strong links with managers across Bedfordshire, Luton and Milton Keynes
* **Development opportunities** – including supervision training, safeguarding and management skills development
* Regular clinical supervision and a Clinician on Duty rota, so you're never on your own with a difficult decision
* A voice in how the organisation is run through our Staff Partnership Forum, plus our Wellbeing Team, Buddy Groups and annual staff Away Day
* Access to BUPA support and Blue Light discounts for charity workers
* Offices set in the beautiful surroundings of Wrest Park, Silsoe
* Most of all, the knowledge that you are making a real difference to children, young people and families at some of the hardest moments of their lives

**Details of the role**

Working hours – 15 hours per week

Salary \- FTE £42,000 \- £45,000 based on experience (actual £16,800 \- £18,000\)

For more information and to view the full job description, visit our website www.chums.uk.com/vacancies

To discuss the role, or to email an application form, please contact recruitment@chums.uk.com. All completed application forms should be sent to this address.

**Please note: CVs will not be accepted for this role – please complete an application form.**

CHUMS is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. This post is subject to an enhanced DBS check and satisfactory references. We welcome applications from all sections of the community, including people with lived experience.

Pay: £16,800\.00\-£18,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Wrest Park

title: Director of Creative, Luxury Hospitality
description:
**Luxury storyteller. Creative leader. Brand obsessive.**
 Luxury is felt long before it is booked. If you know how to create work that makes people stop, look twice and want to be there, this is a rare opportunity to do it on a global stage.
   

  

 Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection and Kimpton sit at the heart of the IHG Hotels \& Resorts Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio. Each has its own character, its own following and its own sense of place. As the portfolio grows, and as our Upper Luxury brands take centre stage, we are creating dedicated creative leadership to protect what makes each one distinctive and push the work further.
   

  

 As Creative Director, you will set the creative vision for our luxury and lifestyle brands and be the senior creative partner to the people who lead them. Your thinking will shape campaigns, content, hotel openings and guest moments, from the first image someone sees to the detail they notice on arrival.

* Lead global multi\-channel campaigns and content that build desire and deliver commercially, across owned, earned and paid.

* A portfolio that speaks for itself, with storytelling and visual craft at a level our guests would expect.

 If you want your work to live in some of the most beautiful hotels in the world, and to lead the creative story of a luxury portfolio in its next chapter, we would love to see it. Apply now.
   

  

*Closing date for applications Friday 2nd October 2026*

 We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
   

  

 We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.
   

  

 Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels \& Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws.
