title: Executive Producer
description:
**Dubai, UAE \| Full\-time, permanent \| Full relocation support** 




  





**Run production for our biggest market, from the ground** 




 The Middle East is Beautiful Destinations' largest market, and it's about to get bigger. We want the person who owns how that work gets made to be in Dubai, in the room with clients and on set when it counts.
 



 You'll lead delivery on our largest client relationship, run our biggest campaigns in the region and work with the best creators in our network. And you'll help shape how a content company built on creators and technology makes work at scale.
 



  





**We are Beautiful Destinations** 




 Beautiful Destinations is a multi\-award\-winning travel marketing company built where travel, the creator community and technology meet. We started as an Instagram account in 2012\. Today we reach a community of 50M\+ travelers and work with a network of 500\+ creators, filmmakers and storytellers around the world.
 



 We partner with tourism boards, hotel groups and travel brands to make content that works across the whole traveler journey, from the first spark of discovery to the moment someone books. Behind it sits an AI\-enabled content platform and more than a decade of our own travel performance data.
 



 Human creativity and authentic storytelling come first. Always. Technology is how we scale them.
 



 See our world:
 
 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 TikTok
 
 \|
 
 YouTube
 
 \|
 
 Beautiful Hotels
 
 \|
 
 Website
 




  





**The role** 




 You'll be BD's senior production and delivery leader in the Middle East.
 



 Your portfolio centers on a year\-round program of work for our largest client: an always\-on creator academy running alongside a slate of flagship campaigns each year. On top of that, you'll own the productions global hotel groups and travel brands bring to Dubai and the wider region.
 



 On a given week you might be checking in with the Lead Producer running the academy, standing beside a senior client on a campaign shoot, scoping a campaign that landed yesterday and shaping a proposal for one that hasn't been sold yet. Every project starts with you once the sale is done. You set the timing plan, the scope, the budget and the approach, then bring in the right producer and let them run.
 



 Once a plan and budget are locked, the production is yours. You make the calls on spend, timing and contracts, and you're the person people turn to when a live production needs experience and a calm head.
 



 And you'll think past the current job. Why sign location managers quarter by quarter when an annual deal would work harder? Where should we use freelance producers, and where do we need permanent ones? How do we move footage around the world? You'll bring those answers, and you'll use your own clients as the test bed.
 



 The success of every BD production is scored on simple questions. Would the client recommend us? Did we make cinematic content that stops people in their tracks, or social content that moves them to act? Did we use process, technology or AI to get ahead of the competition? Your job is to keep those scores rising across everything you touch.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own delivery of our Middle East program of work, keeping the always\-on academy running without a hitch and overseeing 2 to 3 campaigns at a time.
* Turn every newly sold project into a plan: brief, timing, scope, budget and production approach, before handing it to the right producer.
* Lead, coach and back up the Lead Producers and producers running day\-to\-day delivery, stepping in when a production needs you and stepping back when it doesn't.
* Be the trusted delivery partner for senior clients, on calls, in leadership meetings and on shoot days.
* Think across the whole program. Move budget where it does most good, build longer\-term supplier deals, and give us a clear view on how the team should be shaped.
* Deliver great work at strong margins, with a clear read on budgets, actuals and which decisions create or erode value.
* Work with Creative and Creators to pick the right creators for each brief, and hold a point of view on the work itself.
* Run feasibility, permitting, insurance and compliance across the region, knowing where the risks are before anyone gets on a plane.
* Lead your own initiatives to move BD forward, from AI prompt packs that keep 30 editors on\-brand to automating release forms and rethinking how footage is stored and shared.



  





**What you'll bring** 




 We care more about the experience in your years than the years of experience. Around 10 years in production is a good guide, but if you've tackled more in 8 years than most do in 15, we want to hear from you. If you're a senior producer ready to step up to EP, this could be that move.
 


* You know the craft. You've come up through production and know the best way to make great work on budget.
* You're operationally sharp. You can write an estimate, a proposal and a timing plan that actually holds, and push a project through a business without it stalling.
* You're confident with clients. You present solutions clearly, understand what the client is worried about and set up feedback so it helps the work.
* You've owned a program of work, beyond single productions, and thought about it commercially: where money sits, where it should move and what the next year needs.
* You've led and developed other producers and made them better.
* You have a view on the work. You won't write the script, but you'll know which creator fits the concept and when something on screen doesn't feel right.
* You've made cinematic hero films and social\-first, always\-on content, and you understand how they work together from discovery through to booking.
* You're genuinely excited about AI and technology in production, and you have examples of using it to make work faster, better or cheaper.
* You've worked in production companies, creator\-led studios or social\-first agencies, where pace and flexibility matter as much as rigor.



 Experience shooting in the GCC is a real advantage. Experience in Saudi Arabia, one of the region's more complex markets, even more so.
 



  





**Is this you?** 




 You'll love this role if you want ownership, move fast and get a kick out of fixing the way work gets made as well as making it.
 



 It probably won't suit you if you'd rather stay a line producer focused on the next shoot, if you want tightly drawn boundaries around your job, or if you're sceptical about what AI can do for production.

title: Director, Staff Design Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. Our mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to serve their clients and grow their businesses.

  

  

We operate in a space with complex workflows, significant technical constraints, and a high bar for trust and usability. Creating exceptional experiences requires design and engineering to work as one system.

  

  

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Director, Staff Design Engineer** to bridge product design and front\-end engineering, with a particular focus on **user experience, design systems, and agentic software design** .


You’ll turn design intent into scalable, production\-quality patterns and components while helping designers and engineers explore new experiences faster. You’ll work across our design language, UI architecture, interaction design patterns, and capabilities to make it easier for teams to build coherent, high\-quality experiences.


This role is hands\-on. You’ll design in code, build production React components, and work directly with Product, Design, and Engineering to solve complex user experience problems.

  

  

**We can only consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to our Charlotte, NC office.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design Systems \& UI Engineering**

* Build and evolve reusable, accessible, production\-quality UI components and patterns.
* Translate design language, interaction patterns, and design tokens into scalable front\-end systems.
* Partner with designers and engineers to ensure design intent carries through to production.
* Establish patterns that make high\-quality user experiences easier and faster for product teams to build.
* Improve consistency across products while allowing patterns to evolve as user and business needs change.
* Identify gaps between design systems, application architecture, and actual product experiences and help close them.
  

  

**User Experience Design \& Prototyping**

* Partner with Product and Design to frame user problems and explore potential solutions.
* Create prototypes at the fidelity needed to answer the question—from Figma concepts to functional React experiences.
* Use working software to explore interaction models, workflows, and emerging product concepts.
* Help teams evaluate ideas earlier by making realistic experiences available for user testing and experimentation.
* Contribute strong interaction design, visual design, and front\-end perspectives to product decisions.
* Understand advisor workflows and translate complex financial processes into clear, usable experiences.
  

  

**Front\-End Engineering**

* Design and implement complex front\-end experiences using modern web technologies.
* Build maintainable React components and application patterns that can be reused across teams.
* Make thoughtful decisions about component APIs, state, composition, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance.
* Contribute to front\-end architecture and technical decisions that affect the user experience.
* Maintain a high standard of implementation quality through code review, testing, documentation, and collaboration.
  

  

**Design \& Engineering Enablement**

* Improve the tools and workflows connecting design and engineering.
* Help designers work closer to production systems and help engineers better understand design intent.
* Develop shared primitives, examples, reference implementations, and guidance teams can build from rather than starting from scratch.
* Explore emerging tools—including AI\-assisted design and development—to improve how teams prototype and deliver experiences.
* Reduce the distance between an idea, a prototype, and production software.
  

  

**Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Serve as a bridge between Design, Product, and Engineering.
* Mentor designers and engineers in design systems, interaction patterns, prototyping, and front\-end craft.
* Facilitate collaboration around complex UX and technical problems.
* Communicate design and technical tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.
* Influence the evolution of AssetMark’s design language and front\-end practices across teams.
  

  

**About You**

* You think like both a designer and an engineer and are comfortable moving between the two.
* You care deeply about interaction details, visual quality, accessibility, and implementation quality.
* You understand that a design system is more than a component library—it includes patterns, principles, tokens, interaction behaviors, and shared language.
* You prefer working prototypes and real examples over extensive documentation.
* You can move comfortably between Figma and code.
* You enjoy simplifying complex workflows and systems.
* You can distinguish between when consistency matters and when a new problem requires a new pattern.
* You are comfortable working without fully defined requirements and helping teams determine what should be built.
* You favor meaningful user impact over theoretical perfection.
  

  

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Deep expertise in modern front\-end development, particularly **React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS** .
* Strong understanding of interaction design and user experience fundamentals.
* Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems.
* Strong understanding of design tokens, component APIs, responsive design, and accessibility.
* High visual UI craft and attention to implementation detail.
* Experience with Figma and modern prototyping workflows.
* Ability to prototype rapidly in both design tools and code.
* Understanding of front\-end architecture, performance, testing, and maintainability.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product designers, product managers, and application engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted design and development tools and emerging design\-to\-code workflows.
  

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 7\+ years of experience across front\-end engineering, product design, design engineering, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience shipping high\-quality user interfaces in production software.
* Portfolio or body of work demonstrating both **UX/design thinking and front\-end implementation** .
* Experience contributing to or leading a design system or shared UI platform.
* Experience developing complex, workflow\-oriented applications.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Design, and Engineering.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, fintech, or another regulated industry is preferred.
  

  

A traditional educational background is not required; equivalent professional experience is valued.

  

  

**Why Join AssetMark?**

* Shape the experience of products used by thousands of financial advisors.
* Help define the design language and interaction patterns behind AssetMark’s next generation of products.
* Work directly across Design and Engineering rather than operating within one discipline.
* Build systems and tools that multiply the effectiveness of product teams.
* Prototype ambitious ideas and help turn the strongest ones into production experiences.
* Help establish design engineering as a core capability within AssetMark.
  

  

*Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $160,000\-$180,000\.*

This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.*

title: Senior Media Supervisor / Associate Media Director / Media Director
description:
CTP is looking for a Senior Media Supervisor, Associate Media Director, or Media Director to join our growing media team.


This role is for someone who is passionate about media strategy, loves the planning process, and still wants to stay close to the work. We’re looking for a paid media professional who has hands\-on experience planning, buying, optimizing, and reporting on digital campaigns — and who is excited to help shape smart, effective media recommendations for clients.


This is not a social media management, content creation, production, influencer, or video\-only role. The right candidate will have direct experience in paid media strategy and execution, including digital planning, platform buying, campaign optimization, performance analysis, and client\-facing recommendations.


We are open to candidates at the Senior Media Supervisor, Associate Media Director, or Media Director level, depending on experience, leadership depth, client ownership, and readiness for growth. For the right Senior Supervisor, this could be a strong next step into an Associate Media Director role.


CTP is a collaborative agency where the work moves quickly, the problems are interesting, and the best ideas often come from teams working closely together. Our media team partners with analytics, creative, account, and strategy teams to connect client goals to smart, measurable media plans.


In this role, you will lead the planning and execution of integrated paid digital media campaigns, translating client objectives into thoughtful, performance\-driven media strategies. You will help develop plans, manage campaign execution, analyze results, uncover insights, and bring clear recommendations to clients and internal teams.


You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. This person will not simply oversee media from a distance — they will remain close to the platforms, the numbers, the optimizations, and the details that make campaigns successful.


At the Senior Media Supervisor / Associate Media Director level, this role will balance hands\-on campaign leadership with growing client ownership and team mentorship.


At the Media Director level, the role will include deeper client leadership, team development, strategic oversight, and greater influence on the direction of CTP’s media practice.


What You’ll Do


CTP is looking for someone who will contribute to our agency’s success by:

* Leading paid digital media strategy and execution across multiple accounts
* Building thoughtful media plans that connect client goals, audience insights, channel strategy, and measurable outcomes
* Staying hands\-on in campaign setup, trafficking, optimization, pacing, reporting, and performance analysis
* Translating campaign data into clear, actionable insights and client\-ready recommendations
* Strengthening the connection between media strategy, analytics, and creative
* Partnering closely with account, analytics, creative, and strategy teams
* Bringing clarity and confidence to client conversations
* Identifying opportunities to test new platforms, tools, tactics, and approaches
* Mentoring junior team members and helping them grow their planning, buying, and analytical skills
* Contributing to a collaborative, curious, and evolving media practice


Who You Are


You are someone who genuinely enjoys media — not just managing projects, but understanding how channels work, how audiences behave, how campaigns perform, and how smart planning can solve business challenges.


You have hands\-on paid media buying experience, but you also love the thinking behind the plan. You are equally comfortable digging into performance data, building a recommendation, talking through strategy with a client, and helping a junior team member understand why an optimization matters.


You are curious, collaborative, organized, and excited by the opportunity to help grow a media practice inside an agency that values both great work and good people.


Qualifications

* Ability to commute to our Boston office two days per week, Tuesday and Wednesday
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Approximately 6–10\+ years of paid media experience, preferably within an agency environment
* Direct experience planning, buying, optimizing, and reporting on paid digital campaigns
* Hands\-on experience with paid digital channels such as programmatic display, paid search, paid social, online video, digital audio, native, or other performance media channels
* Experience with ad\-serving and campaign management platforms such as Google Campaign Manager, CM360/DCM, or similar tools
* Strong analytical skills and comfort translating data into insights and recommendations
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Strong communication, organization, and time\-management skills
* Experience contributing to client conversations and presenting media recommendations
* A collaborative mindset, with experience mentoring or supporting junior team members
* Natural curiosity about the evolving digital landscape and enthusiasm for testing new platforms, technologies, and approaches
* Familiarity with media research tools such as Kantar, Comscore, Nielsen, Resonate, MRI\-Simmons, or similar platforms is a plus


A Note on Level


We are open to candidates at different stages of senior media leadership. You may be a strong Senior Media Supervisor ready to become an Associate Media Director, or you may already be operating at the AMD or Media Director level. The final title, scope, and compensation will be aligned to experience, leadership depth, and client ownership.


If you are passionate about paid media, enjoy both planning and hands\-on buying, and want to help shape meaningful work in a collaborative agency environment, we’d love to meet you.

*Please note, all employees are required to be in\-office at our CTP location on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.*

*The salary range for this position is $75,000 – $125,000 annually. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, internal equity, market data, and scope of responsibility. Senior Media Supervisor candidates will fall toward the lower end of the range, with Associate Media Director and Media Director candidates aligned accordingly. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and a collaborative, supportive culture focused on delivering breakthrough ideas for our clients.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or in your work once hired, please contact our Human Resources Department.*

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.*

title: Associate Principal Scientist, Combination Product Design Verification (Associate Director Equivalent)
description:
Job Description
  
  

Are you enthusiastic and driven to create and lead execution of combination product testing strategies for innovative combination products?
  
  

Join our company’s Device Development \& Technology (DD\&T) Team, which focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of novel biologic/drug/vaccine\-device combination products for safe and effective delivery to their intended sites of action. The DD\&T Team oversees the development of the device constituent within our pipeline of combination products, spanning various therapeutic areas and routes of administration, including inhalation, implantation, and injection.
  
  

The Associate Principal Scientist will provide end‑to‑end technical and project leadership for the definition, integration, and execution of comprehensive testing strategies in support of the overall control strategy for drug–device combination products. This role has a primary focus on design verification while encompassing the full spectrum of testing activities, including test method development and validation, analytical transfers, incoming testing, in\-process, release testing, and testing readiness to enable successful clinical introduction and commercialization.
  
  

This position plays a critical leadership role across the product lifecycle, partnering with cross‑functional teams and suppliers to ensure testing strategies are aligned with development, manufacturing, regulatory, and quality objectives. In addition to design verification, the Associate Principal Scientist will contribute to and support key validation activities such as drug product manufacturing processes and combination product final assembly process validations, ensuring robust and compliant execution from development through commercial launch.
  
  

As a matrixed project leader, the incumbent will collaborate extensively with stakeholders within and outside of Device Development \& Technology, effectively coordinating teams, timelines, and deliverables to drive testing strategy implementation and execution. Success in this role requires the ability to engage and influence at all organizational levels, translating technical requirements into executable plans that support clinical readiness, regulatory submissions, and market approvals.
  
  

The role requires deep technical expertise across drug and device development, including design controls, risk management, manufacturing process development and validation, materials, molding technologies, design verification, and design validation. Leveraging this foundation, the Associate Principal Scientist will develop and execute integrated testing strategies that ensure product quality, compliance, and readiness throughout the end‑to‑end development and commercialization lifecycle of combination products.
  
  

Principal Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, set direction, align with key stakeholders, and successfully execute, design verification strategies for assigned drug\-device combination product program(s) for successful clinical introduction(s) and commercial market(s) approval(s).
* Define design input(s)/ output(s) and lead associated combination product design verification plan, protocol(s), and report(s) that demonstrate design output(s) meet design input(s).
* Lead establishment of test methodologies, including method development and validation, internally or externally, per design verification strategy.
* Lead strategy and execution of accelerated and real time aging studies including bridging studies at the device component/ subassembly/ in\-process material and combination product level.
* Lead stablishing test methodologies/ testing readiness and execution in support of critical activities such as stability studies, drug product filling process validation, combination product final assembly process validation, shipping studies, etc.
* Support establishment of incoming and release tests at the component and combination product level with key functional areas.
* Oversee design verification activities performed by external partners.
* Proactively anticipate and resolve project obstacles and effectively communicate complex product technical challenges, design verification strategy, timelines, milestones, and risks within our Company and with external partners.
* Author and review relevant portions of the regulatory submissions (INDs, IMPDs, NDAs, BLAs, etc.) for combination product programs under your leadership.
* Lead/ Support clinical supplies production with respect to device component and combination product testing.
* Maintain a high level of engagement with cross\-functional team members to effectively implement and successfully execute against design verification strategies.
* Stay current with new device technologies, relevant worldwide regulations, standards, and effectively share this knowledge with others.
* Enhance our Company’s professional image and competitive advantage through publications, presentations, patents, and professional activities.


Qualifications
  
  

**Requirements:**  

* B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (or an equivalent field) \+ 8 years of combination product development experience; M.S. in Mechanical Engineering (or an equivalent field) \+ 5 years of combination product development experience; or a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering (or an equivalent field) \+ 3 years of combination product development experience.
* Leadership experience of combination product design verification programs and leading activities (e.g., strategy/ plan, protocol(s), report(s), test method development/validation, etc.) requiring cross\-disciplinary project teams.
* Leadership experience with comprehensive knowledge of various aspects of device development and their interdependencies with design verification, including but not limited to, design controls, risk management, materials \& molding, process development and validation, secondary packaging development \& qualification, and design validation.
* Comprehensive understanding of drug product development in addition to device development expertise.
* Strong familiarity with regulatory landscape associated with drug delivery combination product and design verification requirements.
* Strong working knowledge of standards relevant to device components and combination products, including ISO 11608, ISO 11040, ISO 80369, as well as performance tests related to container closure integrity and dose accuracy, among others.
* Proven track record of applying analytical skills in product test method design, development, and validation.
* Working knowledge of analytical test method technology transfer process.
* Skilled in laboratory good documentation practices and electronic documentation systems.
* Self\-motivated with ability to work independently.
* Proven ability to lead teams of different skill sets and backgrounds.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a strategic thinker; able to influence without formal authority; ability to influence and present ideas to senior leadership.
* Excellent communication, prioritization, presentation, negotiation, project management, and organizational skills.
* Willing to travel


**Preferred experiences include:**  

* Combination product drug delivery device components – plastic, metal, glass, elastomeric materials, etc. – fracture, stress\-strain response, friction, hardness, surface roughness, surface energy quantification.
* Combination product sub\-assemblies (including electro\-mechanical) – system tear down analysis, gear ratio optimization, weakest link component identification and optimization, etc.
* Material characterization and failure mode analysis and integration with combination product risk management.
* Stress\-strain testing of different materials under different environmental conditions, i.e., temperature, humidity.
* Eagerness to identify lab capability gaps, drive procurement of new equipment, and quickly upskill (also train others) on operation.
* Experience with analytical or numerical simulation.
* Excellent collaboration and ideation skills, including facilitating brainstorming sessions, developing proof of concepts, and generating feasibility data.
* Strong familiarity with compression/tensile testing (Instron, Zwick, Texture Analyzer), rheology (TA Instrument), metrology/non\-destructive inspection (XRCT \[Zeiss], Optical microscopy \[Keyence], high speed imaging)
* Experience in 3D CAD (Solidworks) and rapid manufacturing techniques (machining, 3D printing) for fixture development and device redesign efforts.


**Fluency with industry\-related guidance \& standards:**  

* 21 CFR Part 4
* 21 CFR 820
* 21 CFR 210/ 211
* EU Medical Device Regulation
* USP
* USP
* FDA Guidance for Industry, Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics
* ISO 13485
* ISO 14971
* ISO 11608
* ISO 11040
* ISO 10993
* ISO 23908
* ISO 80369
* ISTA 3A/B
* ASTM F1886
* ASTM D4169
* ASTM F1980


**Required Skills:**  

Combination Products, Control Strategy, Design Controls, Design Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (DFMEA), Design Manufacturing, Design Verification Testing, Device Development, Drug Development, Human Factor Engineering, Immunotherapy, Mechanical Testing, Medical Device Quality Systems, Process Manufacturing, Product Risk Management, Project Leadership, Project Management, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Test Method Validation, Test Procedure Development

title: General Manager - HBR
description:
**Description**

* Grand Pacific Resort Management (GPRM) is a Southern California rooted company with a world\-class culture and exciting growth plans. Inspired by the understanding that the aim of life is to enrich lives; GPRM was created to help families invest invaluable time away together. Join and grow with us as we strive to make vacation dreams a reality.
* GPRM is searching for leadership talent to add a General Manager to our team.

**DESCRIPTION**: As General Manager, you will be responsible for effectively leading and managing all aspects of the resort operation and for delivering results that contribute to the vision and overall success of Grand Pacific Resort Management.

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Director or Vice President of Resort Operations

**PURPOSE:** Responsible for providing exceptional resort oversight:

* Deliver consistent quality resort management with a focus on maximizing financial performance and service culture.
* Mentorship of resort Associates.
* Liaison between Associates, Board of Directors', Owners/Guests and Management Company.
* Actively participate in the growth of GPRM.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

***Associate Engagement \& Empowerment***

**Retention and Recognition**

* Actively participate in the recruitment of Associate talent.
* Performance Management, including daily development of team members and timely annual review preparation and administration.
* Ensure New Associate Orientation Participation within 30 days of hire.
* Oversee time card record keeping of resort Associates and Managers.
* Manage Associate files, to include disciplinary documentation, positive remarks, training/certifications, reviews and assessments, merit increases, action plans, etc.
* Promote BE EPIC Moments program to highlight positive interactions with Owners/Guests and peers.

**Development**

* Mentorship of team members and other identified Associates to assist in securing a bench of leaders for succession.
* Participate in Grand Pacific University (GPU), and assign applicable courses to resort Associates.
* Create time\-bound action plans for improvement of Associates as needed.

**Engagement**

* Cultivate an environment that embraces BE EPIC values and ensure GPRM's Service Culture is embodied by all Associates.
* Ensure Annual Associate Opinion Survey responses are managed via Manager Action Plans and that GPR Listens Sessions are conducted according to the Standard Operating Procedure.
* Conduct regular team meetings to ensure effective communication of resort team and encourage celebration through monthly team Rallies.

***Operational Excellence***

**Resort Operations**

* Oversee weekly Inventory Management, including preparation and execution of relocations or rental of any vacant units.
* Manage compliance of management contracts and vendors.
* Oversight of resort appearance and Preventative Maintenance (Synergy Program) to the highest standards possible.
* Manage and oversee Construction and FF\&E projects/renovations by verifying a comprehensive and strategic, time\-bound plan is in place.
* Knowledge of resort's CC\&R's and Rules \& Regulations to ensure compliance.




**Brand Standards**

* Ensure consistency and adherence to all GPR Brand Standards \& Standard Operating Procedures (Best Practices).
* Host weekly Coffee Klatch activity to generate face\-time and feedback with resort Owners.
* Follow\-up on Quarterly Resort Audit Action Items and ensure compliance to actionable items reviewed during audits.
* Conduct weekly property walks and monthly property audits with plans to improve results, along with Mystery Shop results.
* Manage Annual Owner Survey action items and focus on increasing Owner Satisfaction scores year\-over\-year.

**Service Culture**

* Customer service standards (quantitatively/qualitatively) are achieved according to goals in all departmental categories.
* Maintain NPS Score at a 75% threshold or higher.
* Monitor and encourage TripAdvisor reviews, and engage with Owners/Guests to improve resort rankings quarterly.
* Support GPRM's Core Purpose "Enriching Lives by Creating Experiences Worth Sharing" via assuring all service best practices are embraced and adhered to.
* Review Exchange Company survey data, along with internal survey data.
* Comments and/or complaints must be appropriately responded to in a timely manner, with corrective action implemented.
	+ Utilize Salesforce daily to monitor Owner/Guest satisfaction scores, various survey responses and Board of Director activity, and provide a plan to improve results.

**Financial (Budgets \& Labor)**

* Develop and prepare annual Operating and Reserves budgets, with a goal of funding reserves at 50% or greater.
* Present annual budget to Board of Directors for approval.
* Monitor HOA delinquency by working closely with the Collections team.
* Oversee resort financial performance:
	+ Preparation of Income Statement (P\&L) Variance Reports within two business days of Financial Review, to include a time\-bound plan to improve if a negative variance to budget occurs.
	+ Utilize Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) report to analyze department expenses.
	+ Ensure a minimum Resort Service Fee (RSF) collection rate of 90%.
	+ Maintain City Ledger compliance by collecting payment on reservations within 30 days.
	+ Manage/Update Schedule of Values (SOV).
	+ Responsible for processing weekly Accounts Payable.
	+ Ongoing Reserve Study management, including updates as necessary to ensure specific threshold adherence.




**Safety**

* Involvement in resort Owner/Guest and Associate Safety, including monthly safety walks, safety meetings and resort\-specific safety programs.
* Participation in Worker's Comp Claims and Incident Reporting.
* Maintain an accident\-free work place, and celebrating safe work practices.




**Board of Directors and Homeowners Association**

* Exhibit the highest level of ethics and integrity consistent with GPRM's standards.
* Produce timely, accurate and mail\-ready Board Packet development.
* Coordinate successful Board Meetings by total compliance to Board Meeting Standard Operation Procedures.
* Monitor Annual Board of Directors Survey results to ensure BOD Member Satisfaction.
* Maintain a strong, working knowledge of HOA relationships; while exhibiting working knowledge of HOA documents, governing statues and Board meeting procedures.
* Negotiate contracts on behalf of the HOA by presenting them in the correct legal fashion and having them vetted for implementation.

**New Business Development**

* Participate in procuring new resorts:
	+ Onsite Lead Generation.
	+ Client interaction (resort tours/entertainment/Management Services Presentation).
	+ Assistance with Resort transitions by self and team members.

**Special Projects**

* Volunteer for and accept special projects.
* Flawlessly execute projects according to identified scope and timeline.

**SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination or knowledge, skills and abilities:

* Ability to diffuse difficult customer situations and adapt to individual circumstances or needs.
* Advanced knowledge of the Timeshare industry and leadership.
* Dynamic team player who can think creatively, manage innovation and effectively challenge existing practices.
* Dedicated to contribute to an energetic team with a laser focus on the GPRM Core Purpose and Values.
* Ability to provide timely, direct complete and actionable feedback to others.
* Demonstrated ability to influence all levels of the organization with their presence and business acumen.
* Excellent oral, written, presentation and public speaking skills. Possess strong financial literacy and analysis capabilities.
* Participate in the development of short and long\-term financial and operational goals.
* Ability to assess/evaluate Associates' performance in a consistent manner.
* Ensure that Owner/Guest/Associate satisfaction is consistently obtained and maintained.
* Advanced knowledge of the key principles and practices within all GPRM disciplines, including practical knowledge for management of Associates and dealing with complex problems.
* Strong organization and project management skills.

**EDUCATION/FORMAL TRAINING/EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor Degree or higher in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related major preferred.
* 3\-5 years proven successful experience in Hospitality industry required. Resort General Manager responsibility experience preferred.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**


The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an Associate to successfully perform the Essential Functions of this job.

* Work tasks are performed indoors and outdoors at resort locations. Temperature will vary depending on location.
* Occasionally required to climb, balance stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Frequently required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate
* Due to the nature of the Resort Hospitality industry, Associates may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs. In addition, attendance at all scheduled meetings, training and seminars is necessary.
* Travel may be required.

 ***Director, Brand Marketing***

* Ability to flex from high level strategic thinking and influencing senior level leadership to driving detailed execution of projects that are on budget and on time.

description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**




Facility Contract Services (FCS) is a Florida\-based contract services company that employs and manages personnel for municipal clients. Our staffing services include administrative support, clerical, accounting, payroll, billing, accounts payable/receivable, purchasing, human resources, supervisory roles, utility services, water and wastewater plant operations, property and general services management, building and landscape maintenance, parks and recreation, and senior and community services. FCS specializes in municipal privatization through a task\-based approach aimed at improving productivity and efficiency.




**JOB SUMMARY:**


Under the direction of the Department Director, this entry\-level position will perform professional work related to the City of Pembroke Pines Landscape Development Code. Work includes plan review, research, inspections, customer service to residents and businesses, and supporting projects that meet the City's landscaping goals. The employee will also work collaboratively with the administration to research, develop, coordinate, and promote effective sustainability initiatives to reduce the City’s impact on the environment. Work is reviewed through observation and written reports for adherence to established policies, procedures, and codes.




**Essential Functions:**

* Review landscape plans for compliance with the City's Land Development Code and Code of Ordinances.
* Inspect landscape materials, installation, and landscape maintenance contracts for compliance; identify deficiencies and direct corrective action.
* Inspect work in progress and completed landscape projects—public and private—to ensure adherence to approved plans, landscape standards, and specifications.
* Prepare preliminary landscape design concepts, working drawings, specifications, and cost estimates for City landscape projects as needed.
* Inform property owners, contractors, and developers of deficiencies in landscaping requirements and explain corrective steps.
* Provide clear explanations of City landscape codes to residents, businesses, and development applicants.
* Respond to and investigate complaints concerning landscape‑related ordinance violations.
* Review and issue permits for tree removal or relocation in accordance with City regulations.
* Complete special projects as assigned by the Department Director.
* Participate in events and/or public meetings during and after work hours. Interact professionally with members of the public and development community.
* Review and Process permit applications for tree removal or relocation.
* Promote proper landscaping practices and sustainability initiatives at City events and after hours meetings.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Applicants must meet one of the following:
* Bachelor’s degree in arboriculture, horticulture, landscape architecture, forestry, urban and regional planning or a closely related field.
* Associate’s degree in a related field plus 2 years of landscape experience; or
* No degree: 5 years of full‑time landscape or landscape inspection experience.
* Additional requirements:  


	+ Valid Florida Driver’s License.
	+ Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with additional design software preferred.
	+ Preference given to candidates with Certification as a Landscape Inspector and/or ISA Certified Arborist credentials.




**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Walking, standing, and outdoor movement.
* Regular on\-site inspections require walking over uneven terrain, standing for extended periods, and navigating construction or landscaped areas.
* Lifting and carrying: Occasional lifting of materials such as documents, small tools, or landscape samples (usually under 25 pounds).
* Frequent use of computers and tablets for reviewing plans and writing reports, requiring clear vision and hand\-eye coordination.
* Regular communication with residents, city officials, developers, and contractors, requiring effective speaking and active listening.
* Periodic travel to job sites within the city, requiring a valid driver's license and ability to operate a city vehicle.




**BENEFITS:**


One of the many advantages of working with the Vesta Property Services family of companies are the great benefits that we offer to you and your eligible dependents. We offer benefits that foster the health and well\-being of you and your family such as medical, dental and vision coverage along with programs to enhance your financial security such as disability, life insurance and a 401 (k) retirement plan just to name a few. Benefits are offered to full\-time employees (30\+ hours per week).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**DRUG FREE WORKPLACE:**


In compliance with the Drug\-Free Workplace Act of 1988, Facility Contract Services has a longstanding commitment to provide a safe, quality\-oriented, and productive work environment consistent with the standards of the community in which the company operates. Alcohol and drug abuse poses a threat to the health and safety of Facility Contract Services employees and to the security of the company's equipment and facilities. title: Director, Growth & Digital Marketing
description:
**Job Description:**


Pluralsight is hiring a Director of Growth and Digital Marketing to run the digital engine supporting new\-logo acquisition and customer expansion. Directing a 7\-figure digital marketing budget, you will be responsible for driving tens of millions in marketing\-sourced pipeline across our mid\-market and enterprise segments globally. Success is measured in pipeline and revenue, not clicks and CPLs.

  

We are looking for a hands\-on builder who can establish the playbook, then scale it across the team to support long\-term growth. You'll build campaigns that pull early engagement through to pipeline and closed\-won revenue, connecting awareness, nurture, and conversion across channels so interest turns into opportunities. You will also lead the evolution of the team and operating model\- creating clear ownership, stronger accountability, and the capabilities needed to scale. This role reports to the VP, Revenue Marketing.

 **Responsibilities:**

* **Digital execution for partner teams**
	+ Translate briefs from cross\-functional stakeholders into demand gen plans, traffic strategy, and budget recommendations to reach their pipeline goals.
	+ Manage paid, email, and digital execution for global campaigns, reporting results back to campaign owners.
	+ Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and intake processes so partner teams launch faster with consistent quality.
	+ Advise campaign owners on where digital will and won't move the number, backed by performance data.
	+ Partner with Revenue Marketing, Portfolio Marketing, Field, Events, Sales, and Customer Success to activate digital programs supporting launches, strategic accounts, ABM, new\-logo acquisition, and expansion.
* **Owned growth programs**
	+ Develop and execute integrated multi\-channel strategies that build awareness, generate demand, and pull prospects through to closed\-won ARR.
	+ Own always\-on digital acquisition programs, including paid search, paid social, and lifecycle nurture, with accountability for pipeline contribution.
	+ Own lifecycle programs across acquisition, nurture, customer engagement, retention, and expansion, using behavioral signals and segmentation to move customers and prospects to the next best action.
	+ Allocate the digital budget across channels and programs based on pipeline and bookings, and move spend when the data says to.
	+ Hands\-on optimization of new programs, channels, and creative.
	+ Direct the media agency as its strategic owner. Set priorities, manage scope, and run quarterly business reviews.
	+ Build scalable digital and ABM playbooks that can be deployed across segments, regions, strategic accounts, and solution campaigns.
* **Measurement, budget, and team**
	+ Track full\-funnel performance from first engagement to closed\-won ARR, sharing insights with campaign owners and marketing leadership.
	+ Perform post\-mortems on closed\-won and closed\-lost pipeline to reallocate spend and sharpen playbooks.
	+ Manage financial forecasting, pacing, and reconciliation with Finance.
	+ Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning paid media, lifecycle, and digital campaign execution. Establish clear ownership and expectations, build analytical and strategic capability, manage performance, and develop leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy and accountability.

* Demonstrated ability to measure digital pipeline contribution in the CRM beyond platform reporting, using multi\-touch attribution or incrementality testing.
* Experience managing and scaling a media agency relationship that delivers results.
* Built repeatable campaign playbooks and intake processes that helped other teams move faster.
* Experience owning or materially influencing lifecycle programs across acquisition, nurture, retention, and expansion.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
**Senior Account Executive**
============================


Full\-Time \| Remote (U.S., preference for California) \| Reports to Director of Sales

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

* Polimorphic is building the operating system for how the government serves its people. Deployed across 100\+ government agencies nationwide, our AI platform is transforming how counties, cities, and state organizations deliver services to millions of residents. Polimorphic is backed by top investors including General Catalyst, M13, Shine, and Pear. Customer service in government is a top\-three problem in the world, and we are positioned at the center of solving it.
* This is not another SaaS sale. When you close a deal here, you are genuinely changing lives: a family who can now navigate benefits in minutes instead of days, a veteran who finally gets connected to the right services, a small business owner who can pull a permit without taking a day off work. The impact is real, measurable, and immediate.
* We are looking for a Senior Account Executive who wants to build something extraordinary at a venture\-backed company in hypergrowth. You will own a territory, build a pipeline from scratch, close meaningful deals, and have a direct hand in shaping how we go to market. This is ground\-floor work with real upside.

**What This Role Is**
---------------------


This is not a quota\-carrying seat where you run someone else’s playbook and wait for inbound leads. You are the tip of the spear in your territory. You will prospect, build relationships, construct compelling business cases, navigate complex buying processes, and close deals. You are selling a category of solution that your buyers have never seen before.

**In practice, this means:**

* You bring energy, urgency, and creative thinking to every deal. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see the gap, build the plan, and move.
* You think from first principles. Government procurement has myths and assumptions baked in. You question what’s real, challenge what’s slow, and find faster paths to “yes.”
* You are as comfortable building a quantitative business case for a city manager as you are building rapport with a frontline department head. You can do both because you understand that great selling is part relationship, part logic, and part urgency.
* You don’t treat objections as dead ends. You treat them as information. You dig in, reframe, and find the angle that moves the deal forward.
* You operate with the intensity of someone building their own business. End\-of\-quarter urgency is not a performance, it’s how you work every day.
* You are a creative problem\-solver. When the standard playbook doesn’t work, you invent a new one. You think about 10X bets, not just incremental improvements.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Own Your Territory**

* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for your region. You own the number, the plan to hit it, and the pipeline to back it up.
* Prospect relentlessly into state and local government accounts through research, networking, outbound campaigns, and creative outreach. Warm leads are a bonus, not a crutch.
* Manage the full sales cycle from first conversation to a signed contract. You qualify hard, build urgency, and drive deals to close.
* Build a pipeline that is real and 4x coverage. You know every deal, its blockers, its timeline, and your next move. No happy ears, no fiction in the forecast.
* Maximize the investments the company is making in marketing, sales development, consultants, and engineering for your territory. These are resources, not safety nets.

### **Build Business Cases, Not Just Relationships**

* Understand your buyers’ world deeply: their budgets, their pain points, their political dynamics. You translate that understanding into compelling, quantitative cases for why Polimorphic is the answer.
* Deliver sharp product presentations and demonstrations tailored to each stakeholder. A one\-size\-fits\-all demo is a wasted meeting.
* Sell the vision of a unified government services platform, not just individual product modules. Help the market understand what’s possible.
* Negotiate and close deals that drive profitable growth. You understand that a great deal is one where both sides feel the urgency to move forward.

### **Feed the Machine**

* Provide accurate, rigorous sales forecasts and pipeline reports. Radical transparency on where things stand.
* Funnel market intelligence back into the organization. In a company this size, an AE who hears the market clearly shapes the product roadmap, the marketing strategy, and the competitive positioning. That’s not optional; it’s a responsibility.
* Stay sharp on industry trends, competitor moves, and market shifts. Share what you learn across the team. Best practice creation and sharing is how we all get better.
* Collaborate with marketing on region\-specific campaigns and represent Polimorphic at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.
* Contribute to building the playbook. We are creating the go\-to\-market motion in real\-time. Your voice, your creativity, and your learnings from the field will directly shape how the company sells.

### **Sell What Hasn’t Been Sold Before**

* Be comfortable operating in ambiguity. We are bringing a platform product to a market that hasn’t seen it. You won’t have a finished playbook on day one; you will build it as you go and iterate based on what you learn.
* Challenge the myths and crutches that slow down government sales. Bring an outsider’s perspective to what can and should be done differently.
* Think like a business owner, not an order\-taker. “We’re tracking to $X, but if we approached the Y market this way, I believe we can get to $Z. Here’s why and here’s what I need.”

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in software sales, with a proven and consistent track record of exceeding targets. We will ask for specifics: what was your quota, what did you close, and what was actually your doing versus inherited pipeline.
* Demonstrated success selling complex, consultative solutions with multi\-stakeholder buying processes. Enterprise experience is strongly preferred. Agentic AI experience is a plus.
* A first\-principles thinker who builds business cases, not just slide decks. You can construct a quantitative ROI argument as naturally as you can build personal rapport.
* Comfort prospecting and building pipelines from scratch. You are self\-motivated, proactive, and do not require micromanagement to perform at a high level.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. You are credible in a boardroom and authentic one\-on\-one.
* Ability to travel throughout your region as needed (likely 20–30%).
* An entrepreneurial, creative, “can do” spirit. You are energized by building, not maintaining.

### **Strongly Preferred**

* Experience at a venture\-backed, high\-growth startup (Series A through C). You know what it feels like to sell in a resource\-constrained, fast\-moving environment where you have to build the plane while flying it.
* Experience selling platform or multi\-product solutions, including land\-and\-expand and upsell motions.
* Private sector sales background with the hunger and intensity of someone who has carried a bag and built a book of business. Government sales experience is a bonus, not a requirement. We value the mindset significantly more than the Rolodex.
* Comfort operating across industries and pivoting into new verticals. You learn fast and adapt your approach based on what the market tells you.
* A genuine orientation toward impact. You are motivated by the idea that this work changes real lives, not just hits a number.

**Who Thrives Here**
--------------------

* You are a workhorse who leads from the front. You don’t wait to be asked. You see the gap and fill it, whether that’s rewriting a proposal at midnight, jumping on a call with a skeptical county administrator, or driving three hours to get face\-time with a decision maker because that’s what the deal needs. You bring the same grit to closing a $50K pilot as you do to architecting a $500K enterprise deal.
* You are collaborative but not passive. You share what’s working, learn from what isn’t, and push the team to get better every week. Healthy competitiveness is great; building a winning playbook together is better.
* You are drawn to this role because you want to build something that matters. Government customer service is broken. Every day, millions of people struggle to access basic services because the systems designed to help them are outdated, confusing, and slow. Polimorphic is fixing that, and this role puts you on the front lines of how fast and how far we go.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary, commission structure, and equity in the company.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) plan.
* Unlimited vacation policy and standard holidays off.
* Professional development opportunities and a clear path to grow into leadership.
* A remote\-first work environment built around execution, not hours logged.


Polimorphic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
**Director of Construction and Design, New Construction (De Novo)**


Heartland Dental is looking for an accomplished construction and design leader ready to take on a high\-impact role. As Director of Construction and Design, you'll lead both the Construction and Design Teams, helping plan, deliver, and optimize a nationwide new construction rollout strategy that supports more than 100 new office openings each year.


Heartland Dental is the nation's largest dental support organization, providing non\-clinical administrative support services to more than 3,100 supported doctors across 39 states and the District of Columbia in 1,900\+ dental offices. Each Heartland Dental supported office is unique to the community and the patients they serve. Supported doctors are the clinical leaders of their practice, retain full clinical autonomy, and establish their own care philosophies. All Heartland Dental supported doctors are united by a common goal: delivering the highest quality dental care and patient experiences.


The Director of Construction and Design leads, organizes, and develops the Construction and Design Teams in new unit growth. Responsible for managing construction and design activities and delivering high quality new units that align with brand design standards while controlling cost and maintaining critical path schedules. In this role, you will report to the Sr. Director of Design and Construction, while directly managing the Sr. Manager of Construction and Sr. Manager of Design, with Construction Managers and Design Managers rolling up under this team. This position works closely with the internal Real Estate, Operations, and Facilities teams. The ideal candidate will have 10\+ years of relevant experience in high\-growth retail or QSR construction and design.


Below is an overview of the duties and responsibilities you would take on in this role:

  

* Develop the vision, strategy, processes, and resources for the Construction and Design departments to scale to support 100\+ new opens annually.
* Directly oversee, mentor, and develop the Sr. Manager of Construction and Sr. Manager of Design, ensuring strong leadership and development of the Construction Managers and Design Managers within their teams.
* Manage all facets of construction for the de novo portfolio including, but not limited to; budget, schedule, General Contractor qualification, VE opportunities, process/schedule improvement.
* Prepare \& present project status reports with team on budget, schedule, and running cost\-to\-date at regular intervals and ad\-hoc as required.
* Utilize cross\-functional feedback and develop relationships with other Heartland teams to elevate construction and design quality and delivery conditions.
* Strategically plan and review Owner\-Contractor contract documents and qualifications, pre\-bid conferences, and evaluations.
* Develop and implement a quality audit program, monitor contractor corrective actions, and ensure a quality project conforming to plans and specifications.
* Develop strategic reporting on external environmental pressures including construction industry trends, regional escalators, and supply chain constraints.
* Collaborate with Field Operations to ensure efficient handoff from construction completion to operating clinic.
* Delegate and strategically plan job assignments to facilitate both rapid growth and efficient construction management.
* Own development program management across the new unit pipeline, ensuring alignment between site selection, design, permitting, and construction milestones to hit target open dates.
* Collaborate on forward\-looking delivery status from a large bench of developers.
* Contribute to regularly scheduled standards management, value engineering, and quality improvement exercises.
* Demonstrate ability to identify project risks, develop risk mitigation \& contingency plans, \& implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks and communicate the same to department leadership.
* Inspect select construction\-in\-progress for adherence to construction documents and specifications in support of the construction team.
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS/BEng/BArch) from a college or university in Construction Management, Architecture, or Engineering and 10\+ years of commercial/corporate construction experience; other combinations of experience and education may be considered with demonstrated leadership experience.
* Experience managing fast\-paced construction and design teams for a multi\-unit brand.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to tailor those to a wide variety of audiences.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with Operations, peers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to drive alignment and results.
* Strong ability to review and negotiate contracts.
* Experience working in a remote and traveling environment.
* Extensive project and program management experience.
* Extensive knowledge of building construction, building design \& project management methodologies.
* Project Management related software experience (e.g., Lucernex, Procore, Ariba, ServiceChannel, etc.).
* Ability to travel overnight up to 50%.

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Experience in Retail Construction or Design Management.
* Strong leadership and team development skills.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent communication and cross functional collaboration skills.
* Strategic thinker with a focus on process improvement and operational excellence.
* Proven ability to drive results in a fast paced, growth oriented environment.
* Adaptable and effective in managing change and evolving business needs.AutoCAD/Revit literacy strongly preferred.

 As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. **Why You’ll Love This Role**
 You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy.
